# Video Editor — Build Plan

Instructions for Claude Code: this is the source of truth for what to build.
Work through phases in order. Tick checkboxes (`- [x]`) as tasks are completed.
Follow all rules in `/CLAUDE.md`.

---

## 1. Product scope

### v1 (build now)
- Import multiple videos and photos (Android Photo Picker)
- Multi-clip timeline: trim, split at playhead, delete, reorder, duplicate
- Speed control per clip (0.25x – 4x)
- Filters per clip (brightness, contrast, saturation, grayscale, warm, cool, vintage)
- Text overlays (text, font size, color, background, position, start/end time)
- Rotation per clip; project aspect ratio (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5)
- Background music track with trim, offset, volume; per-clip volume / mute
- Undo / redo
- Auto-saved project drafts
- Export to gallery: 720p / 1080p, H.264 + AAC MP4, with progress, running in a foreground service

### v2 (do NOT build unless asked)
Transitions, stickers, voiceover, keyframes, chroma key, multiple overlay tracks, 4K, cloud sync.

---

## 2. Architecture

```
Compose UI ──events──▶ ViewModel ──▶ EditReducer (pure) ──▶ new Project
     ▲                     │
     └──── StateFlow ◀─────┘
                           │
                           ▼
                   CompositionBuilder (Project → Media3 Composition)
                      │                      │
                      ▼                      ▼
             CompositionPlayer         Transformer (export)
               (preview)
```

### Package layout
```
com.savie.precut/
├── PreCutApp.kt                 Hilt application
├── MainActivity.kt
├── model/                       Pure Kotlin (no Android imports)
│   ├── Project.kt
│   ├── Clip.kt
│   ├── TextOverlay.kt
│   ├── AudioClip.kt
│   ├── Enums.kt                 AspectRatio, ClipType, FilterType, ExportQuality
│   ├── TimelineMath.kt          durations, clip-at-time lookup, time mapping with speed
│   └── edit/
│       ├── EditAction.kt        sealed class of all edits
│       ├── EditReducer.kt       (Project, EditAction) -> Project
│       └── History.kt           undo/redo stack
├── data/
│   ├── db/                      Room: AppDatabase, ProjectEntity, ProjectDao
│   ├── ProjectRepository.kt
│   └── ProjectSerializer.kt     kotlinx.serialization JSON
├── media/
│   ├── CompositionBuilder.kt
│   ├── EffectsFactory.kt        FilterType -> Media3 effects; TextOverlay -> OverlayEffect
│   ├── PreviewController.kt     wraps CompositionPlayer
│   ├── ExportManager.kt         wraps Transformer, exposes progress Flow
│   ├── MediaStoreSaver.kt       copies output to Movies/PreCut
│   ├── MediaProbe.kt            duration, size, rotation of a Uri
│   └── ThumbnailLoader.kt       frame extraction + LRU cache
├── service/
│   └── ExportService.kt         foreground service
└── ui/
    ├── navigation/
    ├── theme/
    ├── home/
    ├── editor/
    │   ├── EditorScreen.kt
    │   ├── EditorViewModel.kt
    │   ├── preview/
    │   ├── timeline/
    │   └── tools/               TrimTool, SpeedTool, FilterTool, TextTool, AudioTool
    ├── export/
    └── components/
```

### Core model (starting point; refine if needed)
```kotlin
@Serializable data class Project(
    val id: String,
    val name: String,
    val aspectRatio: AspectRatio = AspectRatio.RATIO_9_16,
    val clips: List<Clip> = emptyList(),
    val textOverlays: List<TextOverlay> = emptyList(),
    val audioClips: List<AudioClip> = emptyList(),
    val createdAt: Long,
    val updatedAt: Long,
)

@Serializable data class Clip(
    val id: String,
    val uri: String,
    val type: ClipType,             // VIDEO, IMAGE
    val sourceDurationMs: Long,     // for IMAGE: chosen display duration (default 3000)
    val trimStartMs: Long = 0,
    val trimEndMs: Long,            // exclusive
    val speed: Float = 1f,
    val volume: Float = 1f,         // 0f = muted
    val filter: FilterType = FilterType.NONE,
    val rotationDegrees: Int = 0,   // 0, 90, 180, 270
)

@Serializable data class TextOverlay(
    val id: String,
    val text: String,
    val startMs: Long,              // timeline time
    val endMs: Long,
    val xNorm: Float = 0.5f,        // 0..1 position in frame
    val yNorm: Float = 0.8f,
    val textSizeSp: Float = 32f,
    val colorArgb: Int = 0xFFFFFFFF.toInt(),
    val backgroundArgb: Int? = null,
)

@Serializable data class AudioClip(
    val id: String,
    val uri: String,
    val sourceDurationMs: Long,
    val timelineStartMs: Long = 0,
    val trimStartMs: Long = 0,
    val trimEndMs: Long,
    val volume: Float = 1f,
)
```

Timeline duration of a clip = `(trimEndMs - trimStartMs) / speed`.

### Media3 mapping (verify APIs against the installed version)
| Project concept | Media3 |
|---|---|
| Clip trim | `MediaItem.ClippingConfiguration` |
| Image clip | `EditedMediaItem` with image duration + frame rate set |
| Speed | Media3 speed-change support for video and audio (check current API: e.g. `SpeedChangeEffect` + audio speed processor, or `EditedMediaItem` speed API if available) |
| Filters | `Brightness`, `Contrast`, `HslAdjustment`, `RgbFilter`, `RgbMatrix` |
| Rotation | `ScaleAndRotateTransformation` |
| Aspect ratio | `Presentation.createForWidthAndHeight(..., LAYOUT_SCALE_TO_FIT)` |
| Text overlay | `OverlayEffect` with `TextOverlay` (time-gated to start/end) |
| Clip volume / mute | Audio processor for volume, or `setRemoveAudio(true)` when muted |
| Main clip list | `EditedMediaItemSequence` |
| Background music | Second `EditedMediaItemSequence` in the same `Composition` (mixed) |
| Preview | `CompositionPlayer` |
| Export | `Transformer` + `ExportResult` / `ExportException` |

Text overlay timing note: overlays are applied per `EditedMediaItem`, so CompositionBuilder must convert timeline times into each clip's local presentation time and attach the relevant overlays to every clip they span.

---

## 3. Phases

Each phase ends with acceptance criteria. Stop after each phase for user verification.

### Phase 0 — Project setup
- [x] Create Android project `com.savie.precut` (Kotlin DSL, version catalog)
- [x] Add dependencies: Compose BOM, Material 3, Navigation Compose, Hilt, Room (KSP), kotlinx.serialization, Coil, Media3 (exoplayer, transformer, effect, ui)
- [x] Hilt application + `MainActivity` with theme and navigation host
- [x] Empty `HomeScreen` and `EditorScreen` routes
- [x] `.gitignore`, unit-test setup (JUnit + kotlinx-coroutines-test + Turbine)

**Acceptance:** `./gradlew assembleDebug` and `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest` pass; app launches to a Home screen.

### Phase 1 — Model, import, playback
- [x] All model classes from section 2 with serialization
- [x] `TimelineMath` (total duration, clip at timeline time, timeline↔source time with speed) + unit tests
- [x] `MediaProbe` to read duration/type of a Uri
- [x] Photo Picker (`PickMultipleVisualMedia`) for videos + images; take persistable URI permission
- [x] Create a new `Project` from picked media (in memory for now) and open Editor
- [x] Editor shows ExoPlayer preview of the first clip with play/pause and a seek bar

**Acceptance:** pick 3 videos → editor opens → first video plays, pauses, and seeks.

### Phase 2 — End-to-end export (single clip)
- [x] `CompositionBuilder` v1: one clip with trim → `Composition`
- [x] Preview switched to `PreviewController` (CompositionPlayer) — moved here from Phase 3, see Decisions log
- [x] Trim tool: range slider over the clip, preview reflects trim
- [x] `ExportManager`: Transformer export to app cache, progress as `Flow<ExportState>` (polling `getProgress`)
- [x] `MediaStoreSaver`: save to `Movies/PreCut`
- [x] Export screen with progress, success (open/share), and error states

**Acceptance:** trim a clip, export, and the result appears in the gallery with correct length and audio.

### Phase 3 — Multi-clip timeline
- [x] `EditAction` + `EditReducer`: AddClips, DeleteClip, SplitClip(atTimelineMs), MoveClip(from,to), DuplicateClip, TrimClip — all unit-tested
- [x] `CompositionBuilder` v2: all clips in one sequence, images supported
- [x] Preview rebuilt when the project changes (debounced) — CompositionPlayer switch already done in Phase 2
- [x] `ThumbnailLoader`: lazy frame extraction at low resolution with LRU memory cache
- [x] Timeline UI: horizontal scroll, thumbnail strip per clip proportional to duration, time ruler, fixed center playhead synced to playback in both directions (scroll seeks, playback scrolls)
- [x] Pinch to zoom timeline
- [x] Tap to select clip; selected clip highlighted with trim handles
- [x] Long-press drag to reorder
- [x] Bottom toolbar: Split, Delete, Duplicate, Trim
- [x] Export uses the full composition

**Acceptance:** 3+ clips (including an image) can be split, reordered, trimmed, and deleted; preview plays them seamlessly; export matches preview.

UI for Phases 3–7 follows `docs/design/DESIGN.md`.

### Phase 4 — Editing tools
- [x] Speed tool (0.25x–4x presets + slider); timeline width updates
- [x] Filter tool: horizontal list of filter previews; `EffectsFactory` mapping
- [x] Rotate tool (90° steps)
- [x] Aspect ratio picker (project level), preview letterboxes accordingly
- [x] Text tool: add/edit/delete text, color, size, background; drag to position on preview; set start/end on a text track lane in the timeline
- [x] All effects routed through `CompositionBuilder` so preview == export
- [x] Unit tests for overlay timing (composition-level, timeline time — see Decisions log), clamping across clip/speed changes, NDC mapping

**Acceptance:** a project using speed, filter, rotation, 9:16 ratio, and a text overlay spanning two clips exports identically to the preview.

### Phase 5 — Audio (CapCut-style; rebuilt per user request)
- [x] Multi-track audio: any number of clips, auto-stacked into rows when overlapping; Music / Voiceover / Extracted kinds
- [x] Add music from device (`OpenDocument` audio/* — persistable), inserted at the playhead; Replace keeps slot and length
- [x] Per audio clip: move, trim, split, duplicate, delete, volume (0–200%), fade in/out, speed (pitch kept), voice effects (pitch presets), beats
- [x] Waveforms on audio clips (on-device decode, memory + disk cache)
- [x] Voiceover recording at the playhead (RECORD_AUDIO), preview muted while recording
- [x] Extract audio from a video clip (same timing; clip muted)
- [x] Video clip sound: volume, mute, fade in/out; "Mute clip audio" toggle for all original sound
- [x] Snapping of text/audio bars to beats, playhead and edges (haptic tick)
- [x] One audio-only sequence per row in the `Composition`; audio past the video end is cut
- [x] Unit tests: lanes, placement with speed, every audio action, spec mapping, drag/snap geometry, peak bucketing

Out of scope (AI or online content): noise reduction, AI voice changers/vocal isolation, auto beat detection, sound libraries.

**Acceptance:** exported video contains original audio and music mixed at the chosen levels, with correct offset.

### Phase 6 — Persistence and undo/redo
- [ ] Room: `ProjectEntity(id, name, json, thumbnailPath, updatedAt)` + DAO
- [ ] `ProjectRepository`: save, load, list, delete, rename
- [ ] Auto-save on every edit (debounced ~500 ms)
- [ ] Home screen: grid of drafts with thumbnail, name, duration; rename and delete
- [ ] `History`: undo/redo stack (cap 50) wired into ViewModel; toolbar buttons
- [ ] Missing-source handling: if a Uri can no longer be opened, mark the clip and offer to remove or replace it
- [ ] Process-death safety: editor restores from repository

**Acceptance:** edit, kill the app, reopen → project restored exactly; undo/redo works across all edit types.

### Phase 7 — Polish and release prep
- [ ] Move export into `ExportService` (foreground, `dataSync`/`mediaProcessing` type as appropriate for targetSdk) with progress notification and cancel action
- [ ] Notification permission request (Android 13+)
- [ ] Export settings: 720p/1080p, quality (bitrate) presets, estimated file size
- [ ] Error handling: unsupported codec, low storage, export failure with retry
- [ ] Loading/empty states everywhere; haptics on split/delete
- [ ] Performance pass: thumbnail memory, recomposition counts, player rebuild debounce
- [ ] App icon, splash screen, dark theme review
- [ ] R8 enabled for release, keep rules verified, release build tested
- [ ] Basic UI tests for the main flow (create → edit → export)

**Acceptance:** release build runs smoothly on a low-end device; exporting while the app is backgrounded completes; no crashes in the main flow.

---

## 4. Manual test matrix (use at the end of phases 3–7)
- Portrait and landscape videos mixed in one project
- Very short (< 1 s) and long (> 10 min) clips
- MP4 (H.264), HEVC, MOV from different phones
- Videos with no audio track
- Images mixed with videos
- Low-end device and a recent device

## 5. Known risks
- **Preview/export mismatch** → single `CompositionBuilder` path (enforced in CLAUDE.md).

content.text:
I compared everything built so far with CapCut and added the missing features to [docs/PLAN.md](docs/PLAN.md) as Phases 7–10, with a feature-by-feature table in §6. I then built Phase 6 (saved projects and undo/redo). It builds with no warnings and all 132 unit tests pass, but I haven't run it on a phone and haven't committed it. I did commit Phase 5 first (`3d3cf07`) so the two stay separate.

**What's still missing compared with CapCut:**

| Phase | Adds |
|---|---|
| 6 (done) | Saved projects, undo/redo |
| 7 | Adjust (brightness, temperature, hue…), filter strength, crop and flip, blurred or coloured background, opacity, transitions, clip animations, speed curves, freeze frame |
| 8 | Picture-in-picture overlay tracks, chroma key (green screen), keyframes |
| 9 | Fonts, outline and shadow, text animations and style presets, stickers |
| 10 | Export up to 4K/60 fps, export in the background, full-screen preview, release polish |

All of these can be built with the media library the app already uses. Left out because they need AI, online content, or something that library can't do: auto captions, background removal, AI effects, stabilization, templates, online libraries, and reverse playback.

**Phase 6 – what's new:**
- **Saved projects:** projects are now stored on the phone, so they survive closing or killing the app. Edits save automatically half a second after you stop, and immediately when you leave the editor.
- **Projects screen:** a grid of drafts showing the first frame, name, length and when it was last edited. Each card has a menu with Rename, Duplicate and Delete; delete asks for confirmation.
- **Undo / Redo:** buttons in the editor's top bar, up to 50 steps, covering every kind of edit. Typing in a text counts as one step.
- **Missing media:** if a video, photo or song was deleted from the phone, a red banner appears and the clip turns red on the timeline. You can select it and use **Replace** (now also in the toolbar for any clip), or **Remove** all missing items at once. Export stays disabled until that's resolved.
- **Cleanup:** voiceover recordings that no project uses any more are deleted.

**Please check on your phone** (`./gradlew installDebug`):
1. Make a project and do a few edits, including a voiceover. Press back: the Projects grid should show it with a cover, length and "just now".
2. Swipe the app away from recents and reopen it. Open the project, and everything should be exactly as you left it.
3. Undo several times, across a split, a filter, typed text, a music move and a ratio change. Then redo. Typing a word should undo in one step.
4. Rename, duplicate and delete projects from the ⋮ menu.
5. Delete one of the project's source videos in your Gallery, then reopen the project. You should see the red banner and a red clip. Replace it, or tap **Remove**, and Export should become available again.

Once that checks out, tell me and I'll commit Phase 6 as `feat: saved projects, drafts grid and undo/redo (Phase 6)`. Then I'll bring you the Phase 7 plan (adjust, crop, background, transitions, animations, speed curves, freeze frame).

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. **Primary Request and Intent:**
   - Build PreCut, a native Android video editor (lightweight CapCut/InShot), following `/CLAUDE.md` and `docs/PLAN.md` phase by phase.
   - Per `CLAUDE.md`: plan before each phase and wait for approval; run `assembleDebug` and `testDebugUnitTest`; tick checkboxes; stop after each phase with device test steps; suggest commit messages; flag Media3 API mismatches.
   - Architecture rules:
     - `model/` is pure Kotlin.
     - Only `media/` imports Media3 editing classes.
     - Preview and export both go through `CompositionBuilder`.
     - The `Project` is immutable and edited through the pure reducer in `model/edit/`.
     - Composables hold no business logic and stay under ~150 lines.
     - No deprecated APIs, no `!!`, strings in `strings.xml`, `@OptIn` at the narrowest scope.
   - The user wanted Phase 5 rebuilt to match CapCut, with all audio features except AI ones, and device files only (no library tab).
   - **Latest request (verbatim):** "Alright, look at the already built features(from the first phase to the current one) and compare it with Capcut features. If anything is missing that makes the app super better like capcut, update the @docs/PLAN.md with it and proceed with implementation."

2. **Key Technical Concepts:**
   - **Toolchain:** Kotlin, Jetpack Compose with Material 3, Hilt, Room with KSP, kotlinx.serialization, Coil 3.
   - **Media3 1.11.1:**
     - `CompositionPlayer` is `@ExperimentalApi`; preview and export share the composition path.
     - Composition building: `EditedMediaItemSequence.Builder(setOf(trackTypes))` and `addGap`; `Composition.Builder(List)`.
     - Speed via `SpeedParameters` and `ConstantSpeedProvider`.
     - Volume and fades via `GainProcessor` with `DefaultGainProvider` (fades in a separate processor); voice pitch via `SonicAudioProcessor.setPitch`.
     - Text via `OverlayEffect` with a `BitmapOverlay` subclass and `StaticOverlaySettings` (NDC coordinates, y up). Layout via `Presentation`; rotation via `ScaleAndRotateTransformation` (counter-clockwise, so negated).
     - Available for later phases: `MultipleInputVideoGraph` (preview via `CompositionPlayer.Builder.setVideoGraphFactory`), `GaussianBlurWithFrameOverlaid`, `AlphaScale`, `Crop`.
   - **AGP 9 built-in Kotlin:** `kotlin-android` declared with `apply false` at the root only.
   - **Pure specs:** `compositionSpecOf` produces JVM-testable specs; `EffectsFactory` maps them to Media3.
   - **Audio lanes:** greedy interval stacking via `Project.audioLanes()`; `placementWithin` cuts audio at the video end and handles speed.
   - **Timeline:** custom `horizontalScroll` with a fixed centre playhead and `ScrubSync`; hit testing on the container; shared `TimelineBar` for text and audio bars with move, handles and snapping; `key()` for stable state.
   - **Persistence:** Room stores JSON; `History` handles undo/redo with coalescing; `ProjectSession` does debounced auto-save in an application scope.

3. **Files and Code Sections (most recent work, Phase 6):**

   **`docs/PLAN.md`**
   - New scope: "CapCut parity" and "Out of scope" (AI features, online libraries, reverse playback, cloud sync).
   - Phase 6 rewritten as "Persistence, drafts and undo/redo"; now all ticked.
   - Added Phase 7 "Clip visual tools":
     - adjust sliders, filter intensity, crop/flip
     - canvas: colour or blur
     - opacity, transitions (edge effects, no overlap), clip animations
     - speed curves, freeze frame, Replace clip (already ticked)
   - Added Phase 8 "Overlays (PiP) and keyframes": multi-input video graph, chroma key shader, keyframes.
   - Added Phase 9 "Text styles and stickers".
   - Phase 10: polish, export settings up to 4K/60, background export service, release prep.
   - §6 is the CapCut gap-analysis table; §7 is the decisions log, with new Phase 6 entries.

   **`data/db/ProjectEntity.kt`**
   - `@Entity("projects")` with `id`, `name`, `json`, `coverPath`, `coverKey`, `durationMs`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`.
   - Also `ProjectSummaryRow`.

   **`data/db/ProjectDao.kt`**
   - `observeSummaries()` returns a `Flow`, ordered by `updatedAt` descending.
   - `get(id)`, `allJson()`, `@Upsert upsert`, `delete(id)`.

   **`data/db/AppDatabase.kt`**
   - Version 1, `exportSchema = true`, `NAME = "precut.db"`.
   - Schema file at `app/schemas/com.savie.precut.data.db.AppDatabase/1.json`.

   **`data/ProjectSerializer.kt`**
   - `Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; encodeDefaults = false }`.
   - `decode` returns null on a `SerializationException` or `IllegalArgumentException`.

   **`data/ProjectRepository.kt`**
   - Interface: `save`, `load`, `observeProjects(): Flow<List<ProjectSummary>>`, `delete`, `rename`, `duplicate(id, newId, nowMs): Boolean`, `loadAll`.
   - `ProjectSummary(id, name, coverPath, durationMs, createdAt, updatedAt)`.
   - `InMemoryProjectRepository` (no `@Inject`) is used by tests.

   **`data/RoomProjectRepository.kt`**
   - `@Singleton`; a `Mutex` guards `save` and `delete`.
   - The cover is regenerated only when `covers.keyFor(project)` changes; the old cover file is deleted.
   - `rename` and `duplicate` both go through `save`.

   **`media/ProjectCoverMaker.kt`**
   - Key is `"${uri}|${type}|${trimStartMs}|${sourceRotationDegrees}"`.
   - Writes a 360px JPEG to `filesDir/covers/<projectId>-<hash>.jpg` using `ThumbnailLoader`.

   **`data/VoiceoverJanitor.kt`**
   - `interface UnusedMediaCleaner { suspend fun sweep() }`.
   - `VoiceoverJanitor` deletes files in `filesDir/voiceovers` that no project references.

   **`di/AppModule.kt` and `di/Qualifiers.kt`**
   - Binds `RoomProjectRepository` and `VoiceoverJanitor`.
   - Provides the Room database (singleton) and the DAO.
   - Provides an `@ApplicationScope` `CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Default)`; the `ApplicationScope` qualifier is new.

   **`model/edit/History.kt`**
   - `HISTORY_LIMIT = 50`, `COALESCE_WINDOW_MS = 1000`.
   - `data class History(present, past, future, lastKey, lastAtMs)` with `push(next, coalesceKey, nowMs)`, `undo()`, `redo()`, `canUndo`, `canRedo`.
   - `coalesceKeyFor(action)` returns `"text:<id>"` for `UpdateText`, otherwise null.

   **`model/edit/EditAction.kt`**
   - Added `ReplaceClip(clipId, uri, info: MediaInfo)` and `RemoveItems(clipIds: Set, audioIds: Set)`.
   - Audio actions belong to `sealed interface AudioEdit : EditAction`:
     - `SetClipFades`, `SetOriginalAudioMuted`, `ExtractAudio`
     - `AddAudio`, `DeleteAudio`, `SplitAudio`, `DuplicateAudio`, `ReplaceAudio`
     - `SetAudioTiming`, `SetAudioVolume`, `SetAudioFades`, `SetAudioSpeed`, `SetVoiceEffect`
     - `ToggleBeat`, `ClearBeats`

   **`model/edit/EditReducer.kt`**
   - Handles `ReplaceClip` through `Clip.replacedWith`: keeps the trimmed length (clamped to the new source), plus speed (video to video only), volume, muted, filter, rotation and fades.
   - Handles `RemoveItems`; `is EditAction.AudioEdit` goes to `project.applyAudioEdit`.
   - Text overlays are clamped after every edit.

   **`model/edit/AudioEdits.kt`**
   - Contains `applyAudioEdit`, `normalized(videoDuration)` and the public `clampFades`; `BEAT_TOLERANCE_MS = 150` is public.

   **Model changes**
   - `AudioClip` gained `kind`, `speed`, `fadeInMs`, `fadeOutMs`, `voiceEffect`, `beatsMs`, `displayName`.
   - `VoiceEffect` enum: `NONE(1)`, `CHIPMUNK(1.8)`, `HIGH(1.3)`, `DEEP(0.78)`, `MONSTER(0.6)`.
   - `AudioPlacement(timelineStartMs, timelineDurationMs, sourceStartMs, sourceEndMs)`.
   - `Clip` gained `muted`, `fadeInMs`, `fadeOutMs`; constants `MAX_VOLUME = 2f` and `MAX_IMAGE_DURATION_MS = 60s`.
   - `Project` gained `originalAudioMuted`.
   - `AudioLanes.kt` provides `Project.audioLanes()`.

   **`ui/editor/ProjectSession.kt`**
   - Constructor: `(initial, repository, clock, appScope, screenScope)`.
   - `apply(action): Project?` stamps `updatedAt` and pushes history with the coalesce key.
   - `undo()` and `redo()`; `flush()` saves immediately.
   - Debounced auto-save (500 ms); saves run in `appScope`.

   **`media/MediaProbe.kt`**
   - Added `suspend fun isReadable(uri): Boolean`, which tries `openFileDescriptor("r")`.

   **`ui/editor/EditorViewModel.kt`**
   - `Ready` gained `missingIds`, `canUndo`, `canRedo`, `selectedAudioId`, `audioMenuOpen`.
   - New events: `PickReplacement`, `PickMusic`, `MusicImportFailed`, `RequestMicPermission`, `RecordingFailed`, `NothingToExtract`.
   - Injects `MediaProbe`, `@ApplicationScope` scope, `VoiceRecorder` and `WaveformLoader`.
   - A `session` is created on load. `findMissing` runs on load, and `playable(project, missing)` is what the preview receives.
   - New handlers:
     - `onUndo`/`onRedo` via `showRestored`, which cleans up the selection
     - `onRemoveMissing`
     - `onReplaceClip` and `onReplacementPicked`
     - `onToggleOriginalAudio`, `onClipFadesChanged`, `onAudioMenu`
   - `applyEdit` goes through `session.apply`. `onScreenStopped` and `onCleared` call `session.flush()`.
   - Audio logic lives in `EditorAudio` through the `EditorHost` interface.

   **UI**
   - `EditorTopBar` has undo/redo icons (`ic_undo`, `ic_redo`); Export is disabled while media is missing.
   - `MissingMediaBanner` (plural string `missing_media`, "Remove" button).
   - `EditorScreen` adds a `PickVisualMedia` replacement picker.
   - The main toolbar gains Replace.
   - `ClipView` gains a `missing` red tint; `TimelineSelection.missingIds` is new.

   **Home screen**
   - `HomeViewModel` gains `projects` in its state, `onRename` (trimmed), `onDuplicate`, `onDelete`, and a janitor sweep in `init`.
   - `HomeContent` has a `ProjectActions` interface and a `LazyVerticalGrid` with the drafts title.

package com.savie.precut.ui.editor.timeline

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.height
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.width
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.key
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalDensity
import androidx.compose.ui.res.stringResource
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.Dp
import com.savie.precut.R
import com.savie.precut.model.TextOverlay
import com.savie.precut.ui.theme.TextLaneBar
import kotlin.math.roundToLong

/**
 * Text overlays as bars from start to end. Drag any bar sideways to move it in time (it gets
 * selected); the selected bar also has handles for its start and end. Taps select.
 */
@Composable
fun TextLane(
    overlays: List<TextOverlay>,
    selectedTextId: String?,
    pxPerMs: Float,
    widthPx: Float,
    height: Dp,
    snap: (ownerId: String, startMs: Long, endMs: Long, moveMs: Long) -> Long,
    onSelect: (String) -> Unit,
    onTiming: (textId: String, startMs: Long, endMs: Long) -> Unit,
) {
    val density = LocalDensity.current
    val totalMs = (widthPx / pxPerMs).roundToLong()
    val placeholder = stringResource(R.string.text_placeholder)
    Box(Modifier.width(with(density) { widthPx.toDp() }).height(height)) {
        // The selected bar is drawn last so it sits on top of overlapping ones. key() keeps each
        // bar's state and in-flight gesture when selection changes this order.
        overlays.sortedBy { it.id == selectedTextId }.forEach { overlay ->
            key(overlay.id) {
                fun range(drag: BarDrag) = TimelineGeometry.dragTextRange(
                    overlay.startMs, overlay.endMs, drag.moveMs, drag.startMs, drag.endMs, totalMs,
                )
                TimelineBar(
                    id = overlay.id,
                    label = overlay.text.ifBlank { placeholder },
                    color = TextLaneBar,
                    selected = overlay.id == selectedTextId,
                    pxPerMs = pxPerMs,
                    rangeFor = ::range,
                    onSelect = { onSelect(overlay.id) },
                    onCommit = { drag -> range(drag).let { (start, end) -> onTiming(overlay.id, start, end) } },
                    snapMove = { move -> snap(overlay.id, overlay.startMs, overlay.endMs, move) },
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalHapticFeedback
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalDensity
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import com.savie.precut.media.ThumbnailLoader
import com.savie.precut.media.WaveformLoader
import com.savie.precut.model.Project
import com.savie.precut.model.totalDurationMs

/** Everything the timeline reports back; implemented by the editor screen with ViewModel calls. */
interface TimelineActions : AudioRowActions {
    fun onScrubStart()
    fun onSeek(positionMs: Long)
    fun onSelectClip(clipId: String?)
    fun onTrim(clipId: String, trimStartMs: Long, trimEndMs: Long)
    fun onMove(from: Int, to: Int)
    fun onSelectText(textId: String)
    fun onTextTiming(textId: String, startMs: Long, endMs: Long)
    fun onToggleOriginalAudio()
}

/**
 * Horizontal timeline under a fixed centre playhead: ruler, clips, text and music lanes. Scroll to
 * scrub, pinch to zoom, tap to select, long-press a clip to reorder.
 */
@Composable
fun Timeline(
    project: Project,
    selection: TimelineSelection,
    positionMs: Long,
    loader: ThumbnailLoader,
    waveforms: WaveformLoader,
    actions: TimelineActions,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    BoxWithConstraints(modifier) {
        val density = LocalDensity.current
        val totalMs = project.totalDurationMs()
        var zoom by rememberSaveable { mutableFloatStateOf(TimelineGeometry.DEFAULT_DP_PER_SECOND) }
        val dpPerSecond = TimelineGeometry.clampZoom(zoom, totalMs, density.density)
        val pxPerMs = with(density) { dpPerSecond.dp.toPx() } / 1000f
        val widthPx = constraints.maxWidth.toFloat()
        val halfWidth = maxWidth / 2

        val scrollState = rememberScrollState()
        ScrubSync(scrollState, positionMs, pxPerMs, actions::onScrubStart, actions::onSeek)
        val playhead by rememberUpdatedState(positionMs)

        val reorderState = remember { mutableStateOf<ReorderState?>(null) }
        val reorder = reorderState.value
        val reorderLayout = ReorderLayout.of(
            widthPx, project.clips.size, maxTilePx = with(density) { ClipHeight.toPx() }, marginPx = with(density) { 16.dp.toPx() },
        )
        val gestures = TimelineGestureHandler(
            clips = project.clips,
            hitTest = {
                val stripTop = with(density) { (VerticalPadding + RulerHeight + LaneGap).toPx() }
                TimelineHitTest(
                    project, selection.clipId, pxPerMs, scrollState.value, widthPx,
                    handleSlopPx = with(density) { 24.dp.toPx() },
                    stripYPx = stripTop..(stripTop + with(density) { ClipHeight.toPx() }),
                )
            },
            reorderLayout = reorderLayout,
            reorder = reorderState,
            haptics = LocalHapticFeedback.current,
            actions = actions,
        )

        // Re-cull thumbnail tiles only when scrolling crosses a bucket boundary, not every pixel.
        val bucketPx = 200
        val scrollBucket by remember { derivedStateOf { scrollState.value / bucketPx } }
        val visibleStart = (scrollBucket - 1) * bucketPx - widthPx / 2
        val visibleEnd = (scrollBucket + 2) * bucketPx + widthPx / 2

        Box(
            Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .pinchToZoom { factor -> zoom = TimelineGeometry.clampZoom(dpPerSecond * factor, totalMs, density.density) }
                .tapAndLongPressDrag(gestures),
        ) {
            Column(
                Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .horizontalScroll(scrollState, enabled = reorder == null)
                    .padding(horizontal = halfWidth, vertical = VerticalPadding),
            ) {
                TimelineLanes(project, selection, pxPerMs, visibleStart..visibleEnd, loader, waveforms, { playhead }, actions)
            }
            MuteOriginalButton(
                muted = project.originalAudioMuted,
                onClick = actions::onToggleOriginalAudio,
                modifier = Modifier
                    .align(Alignment.TopStart)
                    .padding(start = 6.dp, top = VerticalPadding + RulerHeight + LaneGap + (ClipHeight - MuteButtonSize) / 2),
            )
            Playhead(Modifier.align(Alignment.TopCenter))
            reorder?.let { state ->
                ReorderOverlay(project.clips, state, reorderLayout, loader, Modifier.matchParentSize())
            }
        }
    }
}

# Phase 5 rebuild: CapCut-style audio

## Context
Phase 5 (one background-music track, clip volume and mute) is built but not committed. The user wants audio rebuilt to match CapCut, with **every audio feature except AI-based ones** (no noise reduction or AI voice/vocal isolation). Music comes from **device files only**, since a Sounds library needs licensed content and a server. Everything below runs on-device with Media3 1.11.1:
- fades: `DefaultGainProvider.addFadeAt`
- voice pitch: `SonicAudioProcessor.setPitch`
- speed on secondary sequences: `SpeedChangingMediaSource` in CompositionPlayer, `ExoPlayerAssetLoader` in Transformer
- multiple audio-only `EditedMediaItemSequence`s with gaps

The current uncommitted Phase 5 work is the starting point. These pieces are reused or generalized: `TimelineBar`, `VolumeSlider`, the `GainProcessor` path in `EffectsFactory`, the `OpenDocument` picker, `importAudio`, `placementWithin` (generalized to speed), `ClipVolumeTool` and the muted badge.

## Feature set (CapCut parity, minus AI and online libraries)
- **Multi-track audio:** any number of audio clips. Overlapping clips automatically stack onto extra rows (CapCut behaviour). Clip types are **Music** (device file), **Voiceover** (recorded) and **Extracted** (from a video clip), each with its own colour.
- **Per audio clip:** move, trim, split at the playhead, duplicate, delete, replace, volume 0–200%, fade in/out, speed 0.5–2× (pitch kept), voice effects (pitch presets: Chipmunk, High, Deep, Monster), and beats.
- **Waveforms** drawn on every audio clip, decoded on-device and cached.
- **Voiceover:** record from the mic starting at the playhead. While recording, a timer shows and the preview plays muted (avoids echo). Stopping drops the recording on the timeline.
- **Extract audio** from a video clip: its sound becomes an Extracted audio clip at the same time (same trim and speed), and the video clip is muted.
- **"Mute clip audio" toggle** at the left of the clip strip mutes all original video sound at once (project-level, like CapCut).
- **Video clips' own sound:** volume, mute (already done), fade in/out, extract audio.
- **Beats:** tap to add or remove beat markers at the playhead on an audio clip, or clear them. Markers show as dots. While dragging, text and audio bars **snap** to beats and to the playhead (within about 10dp, with a haptic tick).
- **Out of scope:** noise reduction, AI voice changers and vocal isolation, auto-beat detection, and online sound libraries.

## Model (`model/`, pure; replaces the single-track actions)
- `AudioClip` gets new fields: `kind` (MUSIC, VOICEOVER, EXTRACTED), `speed`, `fadeInMs`, `fadeOutMs`, `voiceEffect` (NONE, CHIPMUNK, HIGH, DEEP, MONSTER, each with a pitch factor) and `beatsMs` (source time).
- `Clip` gets `fadeInMs` and `fadeOutMs`.
- `Project` gets `originalAudioMuted`.
- **`AudioLanes.kt`:**
  - `audioLanes(project): List<List<AudioClip>>`: greedy interval stacking, sorted by start then id so it's deterministic.
  - `timelineDurationMs()` for audio (speed-aware), and `placementWithin` generalized to speed.
- **`EditAction` / `EditReducer`:**
  - Audio clips: `AddAudio`, `DeleteAudio`, `SplitAudio(id, atTimelineMs, newId)`, `DuplicateAudio(id, newId)` (placed right after the original), `ReplaceAudio`, `SetAudioTiming`, `SetAudioVolume`, `SetAudioFades`, `SetAudioSpeed`, `SetVoiceEffect`, `ToggleBeat(id, atTimelineMs)`, `ClearBeats`.
  - Video clips and project: `SetClipFades`, `SetOriginalAudioMuted`, `ExtractAudio(clipId, newAudioId)`.
  - Fades are clamped so in + out ≤ the clip's length. Splitting divides beats between the halves, and the fade-out stays on the second half only.
- The Phase 5 single-track actions (`SetMusic`, `RemoveMusic`, `SetMusicTiming`, `SetMusicVolume`) are removed.

## Media
- **`CompositionSpec`:**
  - Video items get `fadeInMs` and `fadeOutMs`. Volume is 0 when the clip is muted or `originalAudioMuted` is on.
  - `audioLanes: List<List<AudioItemSpec>>`. Each item has `gapBeforeMs`, the clip range already cut at the video end, speed, volume, fades and pitch.
- **`CompositionBuilder`:** builds one audio-only sequence per lane, using `addGap` before each item.
- **`EffectsFactory.audioProcessors(volume, fadeIn, fadeOut, lengthMs, pitch)`:**
  - a constant `GainProcessor`, then a separate fade `GainProcessor`; a fade's shape replaces the provider's default gain, so they can't be combined into one
  - then `SonicAudioProcessor` with the pitch
  - every stage is skipped when it does nothing
- **`WaveformLoader`** (singleton):
  - decodes with `MediaExtractor` + `MediaCodec` to 16-bit PCM and keeps peak amplitude per 20 ms
  - caches in an LRU in memory and as files in `cacheDir/waveforms/<hash>`, with loading on the IO dispatcher
  - extracted audio reads the video file's audio track
- **`VoiceRecorder`:** wraps `MediaRecorder` (AAC/M4A at 44.1 kHz) into `filesDir/voiceovers/<uuid>.m4a`, and returns the file Uri and duration. It's released in `onCleared`.
- `PreviewController.setMuted(Boolean)` mutes the preview during recording.
- Manifest: `RECORD_AUDIO`, requested when you first tap Record.

## UI (CapCut-like flow, following DESIGN.md)
- **Main toolbar → Audio** opens an audio sub-toolbar: **Music** (file picker), **Extract** (from the clip under the playhead), **Record** (voiceover panel), and **Back**.
- **Selecting an audio clip** changes the bottom bar to its own toolbar: Volume, Fade, Split, Speed, Voice, Beats, Replace, Duplicate, Delete. Each opens a small `ToolPanel`, like the existing tools.
- **Selecting a video clip** adds **Fade** and **Extract audio** to the existing toolbar.
- **Timeline:**
  - Audio rows sit under the text lane, colour-coded by kind, with waveforms and beat dots drawn through the bar's `decoration`.
  - The timeline grows with the number of rows, up to 3 visible; beyond that the lane area scrolls vertically.
  - "Mute clip audio" is a round button pinned at the left of the clip strip.
- **Snapping:** a pure `snapMs(candidate, targets, thresholdMs)` used by `TimelineBar` moves (the targets are beats, the playhead, and audio and text edges), with a haptic tick on snap.
- **Recording panel:** a big record/stop button, an elapsed timer, and a "Recording starts at 0:0x" hint.
- **Composable files stay under about 150 lines:** `AudioRow`, `AudioToolbar`, `FadeTool`, `AudioSpeedTool`, `VoiceEffectTool`, `BeatsTool`, `VoiceoverTool`, `MuteOriginalButton`.

## Tests (JVM)
- Lane stacking: overlaps, touching edges, stable ordering, and stacking after a move.
- Reducer: every new action, including split dividing beats and fades, extract (timing matches the clip and the clip gets muted), fade clamping, and speed and duration changes.
- `CompositionSpec`: lanes and gaps, music cut at the video end with speed, original mute, fades and pitch.
- `snapMs`, music drag (existing), and waveform peak bucketing (a pure function over a PCM array).

## Verification (device)
1. Add 2 songs overlapping in time; they should stack on 2 rows with waveforms, and both play mixed.
2. Split a song, move the second half, fade it in and out, set it to 50% and 1.5×. Preview and export should match.
3. Record a voiceover at 0:03. It should appear at 0:03 and play back. Apply Deep; it should sound lower and keep its length.
4. Extract audio from a clip. A new row should match it, the clip should be muted, and the sound shouldn't double.
5. Mute clip audio: all original sound should go silent while music and voiceover keep playing.
6. Add beats while playing, then drag a text bar near a beat; it should snap with a haptic tick.
7. Export: everything should be mixed as in the preview. In particular, fades should land at the clip ends even on sped-up clips, which can only be checked on device.

## Risks
- **Fade timing with speed:** if `GainProcessor` measures position before the speed change, fades land in the wrong place. Fix: scale the fade positions by speed.
- **Leading gaps in export:** a gap at the start of a sequence might not export cleanly. Fallback: a silent audio item.
- **Effort:** this is roughly as much work as Phases 3 and 4 combined. I'll build it in this order, with build and tests at each step: model and spec, then the timeline rows and toolbars, then waveforms, then voiceover, then beats and snapping.
- **Commit:** `feat: CapCut-style multi-track audio (Phase 5)`

# Video Editor — Build Plan

Instructions for Claude Code: this is the source of truth for what to build.
Work through phases in order. Tick checkboxes (`- [x]`) as tasks are completed.
Follow all rules in `/CLAUDE.md`.

---

## 1. Product scope

### v1 (build now)
- Import multiple videos and photos (Android Photo Picker)
- Multi-clip timeline: trim, split at playhead, delete, reorder, duplicate
- Speed control per clip (0.25x – 4x)
- Filters per clip (brightness, contrast, saturation, grayscale, warm, cool, vintage)
- Text overlays (text, font size, color, background, position, start/end time)
- Rotation per clip; project aspect ratio (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5)
- Background music track with trim, offset, volume; per-clip volume / mute
- Undo / redo
- Auto-saved project drafts
- Export to gallery: 720p / 1080p, H.264 + AAC MP4, with progress, running in a foreground service

### CapCut parity (added 2026-10-13 at the user's request — see §6 gap analysis)
Phases 7–10 below bring the editor close to CapCut for everything that runs on-device without AI
or online content: adjust, crop, canvas, transitions, animations, speed curves, freeze frame,
overlays/PiP, keyframes, chroma key, stickers, rich text, and 4K/60 fps export.

### Out of scope (needs AI, online content, or Media3 can't do it)
Auto captions, background removal, AI effects/beauty, stabilization, templates, online
sticker/music/effect libraries, reverse playback (Media3 can't decode backwards), cloud sync.

---

## 2. Architecture

```
Compose UI ──events──▶ ViewModel ──▶ EditReducer (pure) ──▶ new Project
     ▲                     │
     └──── StateFlow ◀─────┘
                           │
                           ▼
                   CompositionBuilder (Project → Media3 Composition)
                      │                      │
                      ▼                      ▼
             CompositionPlayer         Transformer (export)
               (preview)
```

### Package layout
```
com.savie.precut/
├── PreCutApp.kt                 Hilt application
├── MainActivity.kt
├── model/                       Pure Kotlin (no Android imports)
│   ├── Project.kt
│   ├── Clip.kt
│   ├── TextOverlay.kt
│   ├── AudioClip.kt
│   ├── Enums.kt                 AspectRatio, ClipType, FilterType, ExportQuality
│   ├── TimelineMath.kt          durations, clip-at-time lookup, time mapping with speed
│   └── edit/
│       ├── EditAction.kt        sealed class of all edits
│       ├── EditReducer.kt       (Project, EditAction) -> Project
│       └── History.kt           undo/redo stack
├── data/
│   ├── db/                      Room: AppDatabase, ProjectEntity, ProjectDao
│   ├── ProjectRepository.kt
│   └── ProjectSerializer.kt     kotlinx.serialization JSON
├── media/
│   ├── CompositionBuilder.kt
│   ├── EffectsFactory.kt        FilterType -> Media3 effects; TextOverlay -> OverlayEffect
│   ├── PreviewController.kt     wraps CompositionPlayer
│   ├── ExportManager.kt         wraps Transformer, exposes progress Flow
│   ├── MediaStoreSaver.kt       copies output to Movies/PreCut
│   ├── MediaProbe.kt            duration, size, rotation of a Uri
│   └── ThumbnailLoader.kt       frame extraction + LRU cache
├── service/
│   └── ExportService.kt         foreground service
└── ui/
    ├── navigation/
    ├── theme/
    ├── home/
    ├── editor/
    │   ├── EditorScreen.kt
    │   ├── EditorViewModel.kt
    │   ├── preview/
    │   ├── timeline/
    │   └── tools/               TrimTool, SpeedTool, FilterTool, TextTool, AudioTool
    ├── export/
    └── components/
```

### Core model (starting point; refine if needed)
```kotlin
@Serializable data class Project(
    val id: String,
    val name: String,
    val aspectRatio: AspectRatio = AspectRatio.RATIO_9_16,
    val clips: List<Clip> = emptyList(),
    val textOverlays: List<TextOverlay> = emptyList(),
    val audioClips: List<AudioClip> = emptyList(),
    val createdAt: Long,
    val updatedAt: Long,
)

@Serializable data class Clip(
    val id: String,
    val uri: String,
    val type: ClipType,             // VIDEO, IMAGE
    val sourceDurationMs: Long,     // for IMAGE: chosen display duration (default 3000)
    val trimStartMs: Long = 0,
    val trimEndMs: Long,            // exclusive
    val speed: Float = 1f,
    val volume: Float = 1f,         // 0f = muted
    val filter: FilterType = FilterType.NONE,
    val rotationDegrees: Int = 0,   // 0, 90, 180, 270
)

@Serializable data class TextOverlay(
    val id: String,
    val text: String,
    val startMs: Long,              // timeline time
    val endMs: Long,
    val xNorm: Float = 0.5f,        // 0..1 position in frame
    val yNorm: Float = 0.8f,
    val textSizeSp: Float = 32f,
    val colorArgb: Int = 0xFFFFFFFF.toInt(),
    val backgroundArgb: Int? = null,
)

@Serializable data class AudioClip(
    val id: String,
    val uri: String,
    val sourceDurationMs: Long,
    val timelineStartMs: Long = 0,
    val trimStartMs: Long = 0,
    val trimEndMs: Long,
    val volume: Float = 1f,
)
```

Timeline duration of a clip = `(trimEndMs - trimStartMs) / speed`.

### Media3 mapping (verify APIs against the installed version)
| Project concept | Media3 |
|---|---|
| Clip trim | `MediaItem.ClippingConfiguration` |
| Image clip | `EditedMediaItem` with image duration + frame rate set |
| Speed | Media3 speed-change support for video and audio (check current API: e.g. `SpeedChangeEffect` + audio speed processor, or `EditedMediaItem` speed API if available) |
| Filters | `Brightness`, `Contrast`, `HslAdjustment`, `RgbFilter`, `RgbMatrix` |
| Rotation | `ScaleAndRotateTransformation` |
| Aspect ratio | `Presentation.createForWidthAndHeight(..., LAYOUT_SCALE_TO_FIT)` |
| Text overlay | `OverlayEffect` with `TextOverlay` (time-gated to start/end) |
| Clip volume / mute | Audio processor for volume, or `setRemoveAudio(true)` when muted |
| Main clip list | `EditedMediaItemSequence` |
| Background music | Second `EditedMediaItemSequence` in the same `Composition` (mixed) |
| Preview | `CompositionPlayer` |
| Export | `Transformer` + `ExportResult` / `ExportException` |

Text overlay timing note: overlays are applied per `EditedMediaItem`, so CompositionBuilder must convert timeline times into each clip's local presentation time and attach the relevant overlays to every clip they span.

---

## 3. Phases

Each phase ends with acceptance criteria. Stop after each phase for user verification.

### Phase 0 — Project setup
- [x] Create Android project `com.savie.precut` (Kotlin DSL, version catalog)
- [x] Add dependencies: Compose BOM, Material 3, Navigation Compose, Hilt, Room (KSP), kotlinx.serialization, Coil, Media3 (exoplayer, transformer, effect, ui)
- [x] Hilt application + `MainActivity` with theme and navigation host
- [x] Empty `HomeScreen` and `EditorScreen` routes
- [x] `.gitignore`, unit-test setup (JUnit + kotlinx-coroutines-test + Turbine)

**Acceptance:** `./gradlew assembleDebug` and `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest` pass; app launches to a Home screen.

### Phase 1 — Model, import, playback
- [x] All model classes from section 2 with serialization
- [x] `TimelineMath` (total duration, clip at timeline time, timeline↔source time with speed) + unit tests
- [x] `MediaProbe` to read duration/type of a Uri
- [x] Photo Picker (`PickMultipleVisualMedia`) for videos + images; take persistable URI permission
- [x] Create a new `Project` from picked media (in memory for now) and open Editor
- [x] Editor shows ExoPlayer preview of the first clip with play/pause and a seek bar

**Acceptance:** pick 3 videos → editor opens → first video plays, pauses, and seeks.

### Phase 2 — End-to-end export (single clip)
- [x] `CompositionBuilder` v1: one clip with trim → `Composition`
- [x] Preview switched to `PreviewController` (CompositionPlayer) — moved here from Phase 3, see Decisions log
- [x] Trim tool: range slider over the clip, preview reflects trim
- [x] `ExportManager`: Transformer export to app cache, progress as `Flow<ExportState>` (polling `getProgress`)
- [x] `MediaStoreSaver`: save to `Movies/PreCut`
- [x] Export screen with progress, success (open/share), and error states

**Acceptance:** trim a clip, export, and the result appears in the gallery with correct length and audio.

### Phase 3 — Multi-clip timeline
- [x] `EditAction` + `EditReducer`: AddClips, DeleteClip, SplitClip(atTimelineMs), MoveClip(from,to), DuplicateClip, TrimClip — all unit-tested
- [x] `CompositionBuilder` v2: all clips in one sequence, images supported
- [x] Preview rebuilt when the project changes (debounced) — CompositionPlayer switch already done in Phase 2
- [x] `ThumbnailLoader`: lazy frame extraction at low resolution with LRU memory cache
- [x] Timeline UI: horizontal scroll, thumbnail strip per clip proportional to duration, time ruler, fixed center playhead synced to playback in both directions (scroll seeks, playback scrolls)
- [x] Pinch to zoom timeline
- [x] Tap to select clip; selected clip highlighted with trim handles
- [x] Long-press drag to reorder
- [x] Bottom toolbar: Split, Delete, Duplicate, Trim
- [x] Export uses the full composition

**Acceptance:** 3+ clips (including an image) can be split, reordered, trimmed, and deleted; preview plays them seamlessly; export matches preview.

UI for Phases 3–7 follows `docs/design/DESIGN.md`.

### Phase 4 — Editing tools
- [x] Speed tool (0.25x–4x presets + slider); timeline width updates
- [x] Filter tool: horizontal list of filter previews; `EffectsFactory` mapping
- [x] Rotate tool (90° steps)
- [x] Aspect ratio picker (project level), preview letterboxes accordingly
- [x] Text tool: add/edit/delete text, color, size, background; drag to position on preview; set start/end on a text track lane in the timeline
- [x] All effects routed through `CompositionBuilder` so preview == export
- [x] Unit tests for overlay timing (composition-level, timeline time — see Decisions log), clamping across clip/speed changes, NDC mapping

**Acceptance:** a project using speed, filter, rotation, 9:16 ratio, and a text overlay spanning two clips exports identically to the preview.

### Phase 5 — Audio (CapCut-style; rebuilt per user request)
- [x] Multi-track audio: any number of clips, auto-stacked into rows when overlapping; Music / Voiceover / Extracted kinds
- [x] Add music from device (`OpenDocument` audio/* — persistable), inserted at the playhead; Replace keeps slot and length
- [x] Per audio clip: move, trim, split, duplicate, delete, volume (0–200%), fade in/out, speed (pitch kept), voice effects (pitch presets), beats
- [x] Waveforms on audio clips (on-device decode, memory + disk cache)
- [x] Voiceover recording at the playhead (RECORD_AUDIO), preview muted while recording
- [x] Extract audio from a video clip (same timing; clip muted)
- [x] Video clip sound: volume, mute, fade in/out; "Mute clip audio" toggle for all original sound
- [x] Snapping of text/audio bars to beats, playhead and edges (haptic tick)
- [x] One audio-only sequence per row in the `Composition`; audio past the video end is cut
- [x] Unit tests: lanes, placement with speed, every audio action, spec mapping, drag/snap geometry, peak bucketing

Out of scope (AI or online content): noise reduction, AI voice changers/vocal isolation, auto beat detection, sound libraries.

**Acceptance:** exported video contains original audio and music mixed at the chosen levels, with correct offset.

### Phase 6 — Persistence, drafts and undo/redo
- [x] Room: `ProjectEntity(id, name, json, thumbnailPath, durationMs, updatedAt)` + DAO
- [x] `ProjectRepository`: save, load, observe list, delete, rename, duplicate
- [x] Auto-save on every edit (debounced ~500 ms) and on leaving the editor
- [x] Draft cover thumbnails (first frame of the first clip) saved with the project
- [x] Home screen (CapCut "Projects"): grid of drafts with cover, name, duration, last edited; rename, duplicate and delete
- [x] `History`: undo/redo stack (cap 50, rapid edits to the same target coalesced) wired into ViewModel; top-bar buttons
- [x] Missing-source handling: unreadable media is marked on the timeline; remove all missing, or replace a missing clip
- [x] Process-death safety: editor restores from repository
- [x] Voiceover file cleanup when projects or voiceovers are deleted

**Acceptance:** edit, kill the app, reopen → project restored exactly; undo/redo works across all edit types.

### Phase 7 — Clip visual tools (CapCut "Edit" menu)
- [ ] **Adjust:** brightness, contrast, saturation, exposure, temperature, tint, hue, vignette sliders per clip (stack with filters)
- [ ] **Filter intensity** slider (0–100%)
- [ ] **Crop:** free and fixed ratios on the preview, plus flip horizontal / vertical
- [ ] **Canvas / background:** fill the letterbox with black, a colour, or a blurred copy of the clip (`GaussianBlurWithFrameOverlaid`)
- [ ] **Opacity** per clip
- [ ] **Transitions** between clips: fade through black/white, flash, zoom in/out, blur, slide; adjustable duration. Applied as edge effects on the two neighbouring clips (no overlap, total length unchanged)
- [ ] **Clip animations** in/out/combo: fade, zoom, slide, spin
- [ ] **Speed curves:** presets (Montage, Hero, Bullet, Jump cut, Flash in/out) via a variable `SpeedProvider`; timeline math handles variable speed
- [ ] **Freeze frame:** insert a still (photo clip) of the frame under the playhead, splitting the clip
- [x] **Replace clip** (keeps position, length and settings) — built in Phase 6 for missing media
- [ ] Unit tests for every new action and spec mapping (curve integration, transition edge timing)

**Acceptance:** a project with adjust + crop + blurred canvas + 2 transitions + an animation + a speed curve + a freeze frame exports identically to the preview.

### Phase 8 — Overlays (PiP) and keyframes
- [ ] Overlay track(s): add video/photo as picture-in-picture; overlays auto-stack into rows like audio
- [ ] Composition gets extra video sequences; preview uses `MultipleInputVideoGraph`; per-input placement through `VideoCompositorSettings`
- [ ] Transform overlays directly on the preview: drag, pinch-scale, two-finger rotate; snap to centre lines
- [ ] Overlay opacity, rotation, crop/adjust/filter reuse, animations, "Switch to main track" / "Switch to overlay"

---

## 4. Manual test matrix (use at the end of phases 3–10)
- Portrait and landscape videos mixed in one project
- Very short (< 1 s) and long (> 10 min) clips
- MP4 (H.264), HEVC, MOV from different phones
- Videos with no audio track
- Images mixed with videos
- Low-end device and a recent device

## 5. Known risks
- **Preview/export mismatch** → single `CompositionBuilder` path (enforced in CLAUDE.md).
- **Device codec limits** → use Transformer fallback/encoder settings; catch `ExportException` and offer a lower resolution.
- **Memory pressure from thumbnails** → low-res frames, LRU cache, cancel off-screen loads.
- **Media3 API changes** → verify against the installed version's sources; document workarounds here.

Claude Code: append significant technical decisions or deviations from this plan here, with a one-line reason.

- **2026-10-12 — Import goes through `MediaImporter`** (persistable permission + `MediaProbe`) so `HomeViewModel` is unit-testable with a fake.
- **2026-10-12 — `di/AppModule` added** (not in the original layout) for Hilt bindings, `Clock` and the IO dispatcher.
- **2026-10-12 — Projects start with a blank `name`;** naming/rename UI arrives in Phase 6. Until then the in-memory repository means projects don't survive process death (Editor shows "no longer available").
- **2026-10-12 — CompositionPlayer switch moved from Phase 3 into Phase 2.** The trim preview would otherwise need a second, non-`CompositionBuilder` code path, which CLAUDE.md forbids.
- **2026-10-12 — `CompositionPlayer` is `@ExperimentalApi` (stricter than `@UnstableApi`) in Media3 1.11.1.** It's the only way to preview a `Composition`; the opt-in is confined to `PreviewController`. Every `EditedMediaItem` must have `setDurationUs` (source duration, pre-clipping) for it.
- **2026-10-12 — `CompositionBuilder` is split into a pure `compositionSpecOf(Project)` (JVM unit-tested) and a thin Media3 conversion,** because Media3 `MediaItem` needs `android.net.Uri`, which doesn't work in JVM tests.
- **2026-10-12 — Sequences use `EditedMediaItemSequence.Builder(setOf(AUDIO, VIDEO))`;** the item-list constructors are deprecated in 1.11.
- **2026-10-12 — ViewModels depend on `VideoExporter` / `MediaSaver` interfaces,** never on `Composition`; `ExportManager` builds the composition itself.
- **2026-10-12 — Route args are read with `SavedStateHandle.requireProjectId()`** instead of `toRoute()`, which needs Android's Bundle and breaks JVM ViewModel tests. `RoutesTest` guards the argument name.
- **2026-10-12 — Android 8–9 export saving uses the deprecated `getExternalStoragePublicDirectory` + `WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE` (maxSdk 28),** suppressed at the narrowest scope; there is no non-deprecated alternative before API 29.
- **2026-10-12 — Design system defined in-house** (`docs/design/DESIGN.md`) instead of waiting for Sleek designs: dark-only, accent `#FF4D6D`, no dynamic colour.
- **2026-10-12 — Every composition item gets a `Presentation` (fit into the project frame, 1080 short side)** from Phase 3, not Phase 4: without a fixed output size, mixed portrait/landscape clips and full-resolution photos export at the wrong size or fail. Only the aspect-ratio *picker* remains in Phase 4.
- **2026-10-12 — Photo clips: `sourceDurationMs` = 60 s max, trim range = display duration (default 3 s),** so a photo can be lengthened with its trim handles, not just shortened.
- **2026-10-12 — Clip tools act on the selected clip, else the clip under the playhead.** Split always acts at the playhead.
- **2026-10-12 — Timeline is a custom `horizontalScroll` with manual thumbnail culling,** not a LazyRow: clip widths are time-proportional and the content must stay aligned with the ruler and playhead. Zoom is capped so content stays under ~120k px (Compose's layout limit is ~262k).
- **2026-10-12 — Tap and long-press-to-reorder are detected on the timeline container,** not per clip, so the gesture survives the switch to reorder tiles mid-gesture. Long-presses within 24dp of the selected clip's edges are left to the trim handles.
- **2026-10-13 — Text overlays are one composition-level `OverlayEffect` in timeline time,** not per-item effects mapped into each clip's local time. Both CompositionPlayer and Transformer apply `Composition.effects` (single sequence → SingleInputVideoGraph). Media3 doesn't document composition-level timestamps; **verify on device** that text timing matches in preview and export. Fallback: the per-item mapping from the original plan.
- **2026-10-13 — Text sizing convention:** `textSizeSp` = sp on a 360dp-wide screen, scaled to the output's short side (`textSizePx`). The preview drag ghost and `TextOverlayRenderer` share the padding/corner ratios.
- **2026-10-13 — Speed uses `EditedMediaItem.setSpeed(SpeedParameters(constant, shouldMaintainPitch = true))`** — supported by both CompositionPlayer and Transformer; `SpeedParameters` is `@ExperimentalApi` (opt-in in `CompositionBuilder`). Sped-up clips are capped at 60 fps.
- **2026-10-13 — Rotation is clockwise in the model;** `EffectsFactory` negates it because Media3 rotates counter-clockwise.
- **2026-10-13 — Filters are pure `FilterEffect` specs mapped to Media3 in `EffectsFactory`;** picker thumbnails use Compose colour-matrix approximations (`FilterPreviewMatrix`). Vintage = 80% sepia matrix + slight contrast reduction.
- **2026-10-13 — The reducer clamps text overlays after every edit** (timeline shrink, speed change, delete); with no clips, texts are dropped. A text left blank when its panel closes is deleted.
- **2026-10-13 — Text bars move in time by dragging:** a selected bar's body drags horizontally; an unselected bar needs a long-press first so normal drags still scrub. Moves keep the length and stay inside the timeline (`TimelineGeometry.moveRange`).
- **2026-10-13 — Music is picked with `OpenDocument`, not `GetContent`:** only OpenDocument Uris can be persisted, which Phase 6 drafts need.
- **2026-10-13 — Phase 5 rebuilt CapCut-style (user request):** multi-track audio replaces the single music track. Rows are derived (`Project.audioLanes`, greedy stacking), not stored. Each row is an audio-only `EditedMediaItemSequence` with `addGap` before each clip; placement (`placementWithin`, speed-aware) cuts audio at the video end, so output length never depends on Media3's multi-sequence rules. Audio isn't destructively trimmed when the video shrinks. **Verify on device** that leading gaps export correctly; fallback is a silent audio item.
- **2026-10-13 — Audio processing chain per item:** constant `GainProcessor` (volume) → separate fade `GainProcessor` (a fade's shape replaces, not scales, the provider gain) → `SonicAudioProcessor` (voice pitch). Fade positions are in timeline (post-speed) time; **verify on device** for sped-up clips.
- **2026-10-13 — Audio actions are a sealed `EditAction.AudioEdit` subtype** handled in `AudioEdits.kt`, keeping both `when`s exhaustive. Editor audio logic lives in `EditorAudio` (via `EditorHost`) to keep the ViewModel manageable.
- **2026-10-13 — Audio bars draw only their audible part (up to the video end)** so widths stay bounded by the video's zoom cap; the end handle trims from the audible end.
- **2026-10-13 — Voiceovers are app-private files** (`filesDir/voiceovers`); deleting a voiceover clip doesn't delete its file yet (cleanup belongs with Phase 6 persistence). No timeline vertical scrolling: the timeline grows with the number of audio rows.
- **2026-10-13 — Volume is a `GainProcessor` (constant `DefaultGainProvider`) per item, 0–200%;** omitted at 100%. Clips have a separate `muted` flag so unmuting restores the volume.
- **2026-10-13 — Text and audio bars share `TimelineBar`** (drag body to move, handles to trim, commit on release, optional snapping). The audio start handle trims the source and moves the start together so the remaining audio stays in place.
- **2026-10-13 — CapCut gap analysis added (§6) and the plan extended with Phases 7–10** at the user's request. Persistence/undo (Phase 6) stays first: every later feature needs undo, and drafts are core CapCut behaviour.
- **2026-10-13 — Projects are stored in Room as JSON** (`ProjectEntity.json`) plus list columns (name, cover, duration, dates). `ProjectSerializer` ignores unknown keys and omits defaults, so drafts survive model changes without migrations for additive fields.
- **2026-10-13 — Draft covers** are JPEGs of the first clip's first frame (via `ThumbnailLoader`), regenerated only when the first clip changes, with a new file name per change so Coil never shows a stale image.
- **2026-10-13 — Undo/redo is a pure `History`** (cap 50); text typing on the same overlay within 1 s coalesces into one step. `ProjectSession` owns history and debounced (500 ms) auto-save; saves run in an application-scoped `CoroutineScope` so the final flush on leaving the editor completes.
- **2026-10-13 — Missing media** is detected on open (`MediaProbe.isReadable`); the preview plays the rest, export is disabled until the media is replaced (`ReplaceClip`, audio Replace) or removed (`RemoveItems`, one undo step).
- **2026-10-13 — Unused voiceover files are swept on the Projects screen only,** never while an editor is open (its undo history may still need them).

354	- **2026-10-12 — Projects start with a blank `name`;** naming/rename UI arrives in Phase 6. Until then the in-memory repository means projects don't survive process death (Editor shows "no longer available").
355	- **2026-10-12 — CompositionPlayer switch moved from Phase 3 into Phase 2.** The trim preview would otherwise need a second, non-`CompositionBuilder` code path, which CLAUDE.md forbids.
356	- **2026-10-12 — `CompositionPlayer` is `@ExperimentalApi` (stricter than `@UnstableApi`) in Media3 1.11.1.** It's the only way to preview a `Composition`; the opt-in is confined to `PreviewController`. Every `EditedMediaItem` must have `setDurationUs` (source duration, pre-clipping) for it.
357	- **2026-10-12 — `CompositionBuilder` is split into a pure `compositionSpecOf(Project)` (JVM unit-tested) and a thin Media3 conversion,** because Media3 `MediaItem` needs `android.net.Uri`, which doesn't work in JVM tests.
358	- **2026-10-12 — Sequences use `EditedMediaItemSequence.Builder(setOf(AUDIO, VIDEO))`;** the item-list constructors are deprecated in 1.11.
359	- **2026-10-12 — ViewModels depend on `VideoExporter` / `MediaSaver` interfaces,** never on `Composition`; `ExportManager` builds the composition itself.
360	- **2026-10-12 — Route args are read with `SavedStateHandle.requireProjectId()`** instead of `toRoute()`, which needs Android's Bundle and breaks JVM ViewModel tests. `RoutesTest` guards the argument name.
361	- **2026-10-12 — Android 8–9 export saving uses the deprecated `getExternalStoragePublicDirectory` + `WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE` (maxSdk 28),** suppressed at the narrowest scope; there is no non-deprecated alternative before API 29.
362	- **2026-10-12 — Design system defined in-house** (`docs/design/DESIGN.md`) instead of waiting for Sleek designs: dark-only, accent `#FF4D6D`, no dynamic colour.
363	- **2026-10-12 — Every composition item gets a `Presentation` (fit into the project frame, 1080 short side)** from Phase 3, not Phase 4: without a fixed output size, mixed portrait/landscape clips and full-resolution photos export at the wrong size or fail. Only the aspect-ratio *picker* remains in Phase 4.
364	- **2026-10-12 — Photo clips: `sourceDurationMs` = 60 s max, trim range = display duration (default 3 s),** so a photo can be lengthened with its trim handles, not just shortened.
365	- **2026-10-12 — Clip tools act on the selected clip, else the clip under the playhead.** Split always acts at the playhead.
366	- **2026-10-12 — Timeline is a custom `horizontalScroll` with manual thumbnail culling,** not a LazyRow: clip widths are time-proportional and the content must stay aligned with the ruler and playhead. Zoom is capped so content stays under ~120k px (Compose's layout limit is ~262k).
367	- **2026-10-12 — Tap and long-press-to-reorder are detected on the timeline container,** not per clip, so the gesture survives the switch to reorder tiles mid-gesture. Long-presses within 24dp of the selected clip's edges are left to the trim handles.
368	- **2026-10-13 — Text overlays are one composition-level `OverlayEffect` in timeline time,** not per-item effects mapped into each clip's local time. Both CompositionPlayer and Transformer apply `Composition.effects` (single sequence → SingleInputVideoGraph). Media3 doesn't document composition-level timestamps; **verify on device** that text timing matches in preview and export. Fallback: the per-item mapping from the original plan.
369	- **2026-10-13 — Text sizing convention:** `textSizeSp` = sp on a 360dp-wide screen, scaled to the output's short side (`textSizePx`). The preview drag ghost and `TextOverlayRenderer` share the padding/corner ratios.
370	- **2026-10-13 — Speed uses `EditedMediaItem.setSpeed(SpeedParameters(constant, shouldMaintainPitch = true))`** — supported by both CompositionPlayer and Transformer; `SpeedParameters` is `@ExperimentalApi` (opt-in in `CompositionBuilder`). Sped-up clips are capped at 60 fps.
371	- **2026-10-13 — Rotation is clockwise in the model;** `EffectsFactory` negates it because Media3 rotates counter-clockwise.
372	- **2026-10-13 — Filters are pure `FilterEffect` specs mapped to Media3 in `EffectsFactory`;** picker thumbnails use Compose colour-matrix approximations (`FilterPreviewMatrix`). Vintage = 80% sepia matrix + slight contrast reduction.
373	- **2026-10-13 — The reducer clamps text overlays after every edit** (timeline shrink, speed change, delete); with no clips, texts are dropped. A text left blank when its panel closes is deleted.
374	- **2026-10-13 — Text bars move in time by dragging:** a selected bar's body drags horizontally; an unselected bar needs a long-press first so normal drags still scrub. Moves keep the length and stay inside the timeline (`TimelineGeometry.moveRange`).
375	- **2026-10-13 — Music is picked with `OpenDocument`, not `GetContent`:** only OpenDocument Uris can be persisted, which Phase 6 drafts need.
376	- **2026-10-13 — Phase 5 rebuilt CapCut-style (user request):** multi-track audio replaces the single music track. Rows are derived (`Project.audioLanes`, greedy stacking), not stored. Each row is an audio-only `EditedMediaItemSequence` with `addGap` before each clip; placement (`placementWithin`, speed-aware) cuts audio at the video end, so output length never depends on Media3's multi-sequence rules. Audio isn't destructively trimmed when the video shrinks. **Verify on device** that leading gaps export correctly; fallback is a silent audio item.
377	- **2026-10-13 — Audio processing chain per item:** constant `GainProcessor` (volume) → separate fade `GainProcessor` (a fade's shape replaces, not scales, the provider gain) → `SonicAudioProcessor` (voice pitch). Fade positions are in timeline (post-speed) time; **verify on device** for sped-up clips.
378	- **2026-10-13 — Audio actions are a sealed `EditAction.AudioEdit` subtype** handled in `AudioEdits.kt`, keeping both `when`s exhaustive. Editor audio logic lives in `EditorAudio` (via `EditorHost`) to keep the ViewModel manageable.
379	- **2026-10-13 — Audio bars draw only their audible part (up to the video end)** so widths stay bounded by the video's zoom cap; the end handle trims from the audible end.
380	- **2026-10-13 — Voiceovers are app-private files** (`filesDir/voiceovers`); deleting a voiceover clip doesn't delete its file yet (cleanup belongs with Phase 6 persistence). No timeline vertical scrolling: the timeline grows with the number of audio rows.
381	- **2026-10-13 — Volume is a `GainProcessor` (constant `DefaultGainProvider`) per item, 0–200%;** omitted at 100%. Clips have a separate `muted` flag so unmuting restores the volume.
382	- **2026-10-13 — Text and audio bars share `TimelineBar`** (drag body to move, handles to trim, commit on release, optional snapping). The audio start handle trims the source and moves the start together so the remaining audio stays in place.
383	- **2026-10-13 — CapCut gap analysis added (§6) and the plan extended with Phases 7–10** at the user's request. Persistence/undo (Phase 6) stays first: every later feature needs undo, and drafts are core CapCut behaviour.
384	- **2026-10-13 — Projects are stored in Room as JSON** (`ProjectEntity.json`) plus list columns (name, cover, duration, dates). `ProjectSerializer` ignores unknown keys and omits defaults, so drafts survive model changes without migrations for additive fields.
385	- **2026-10-13 — Draft covers** are JPEGs of the first clip's first frame (via `ThumbnailLoader`), regenerated only when the first clip changes, with a new file name per change so Coil never shows a stale image.
386	- **2026-10-13 — Undo/redo is a pure `History`** (cap 50); text typing on the same overlay within 1 s coalesces into one step. `ProjectSession` owns history and debounced (500 ms) auto-save; saves run in an application-scoped `CoroutineScope` so the final flush on leaving the editor completes.
387	- **2026-10-13 — Missing media** is detected on open (`MediaProbe.isReadable`); the preview plays the rest, export is disabled until the media is replaced (`ReplaceClip`, audio Replace) or removed (`RemoveItems`, one undo step).
388	- **2026-10-13 — Unused voiceover files are swept on the Projects screen only,** never while an editor is open (its undo history may still need them).
389	
</system-reminder>

# CLAUDE.md — Android Video Editor

This file is read at the start of every session. Follow it strictly.

## Project
A native Android video editor (similar in scope to a lightweight InShot/CapCut).
The full specification, architecture, and phased task list live in `docs/PLAN.md`.
**Always read `docs/PLAN.md` before starting work.**

## Stack
- Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3
- MVVM + unidirectional data flow (StateFlow), Hilt for DI
- AndroidX Media3: ExoPlayer, Transformer, Effects, CompositionPlayer
- Room for persistence, kotlinx.serialization for project JSON
- Coil for images/thumbnails
- Gradle Kotlin DSL with a version catalog (`gradle/libs.versions.toml`)
- minSdk 26, targetSdk/compileSdk = latest stable

## Workflow rules
1. Work on **one phase at a time**, in the order given in `docs/PLAN.md`.
2. Before coding a phase, write a short plan (files to create/change, approach) and wait for approval.
3. After every meaningful change, run `./gradlew assembleDebug` and fix all errors and warnings you introduced.
4. Run `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest` before declaring a task done.
5. When a task is complete, tick its checkbox in `docs/PLAN.md`.
6. At the end of each phase, STOP. Summarize what was built and list the manual test steps from the phase's acceptance criteria so the user can verify on a device. Do not start the next phase until the user confirms.
7. Suggest a git commit message at the end of each completed task.
8. If something in the plan is technically wrong or a Media3 API differs from what the plan assumes, say so and propose a fix instead of silently deviating.

## Architecture rules
- `model/` contains pure Kotlin data classes only. No Android, Compose, or Media3 imports.
- Only `media/` may import Media3 editing classes (Transformer, Composition, Effects).
- Preview and export MUST both use `CompositionBuilder` to produce the same `Composition`. Never build a separate code path for preview.
- The editor state is an immutable `Project`. Every edit produces a new `Project` via a pure function in `model/edit/`. This enables undo/redo.
- Composables contain no business logic. They render state and send events to the ViewModel.
- Keep composables small (prefer < 150 lines per file).

## Media3 rules
- Use the latest **stable** Media3 version from Google Maven. Verify API signatures against that version's sources rather than relying on memory; Media3 APIs change between releases.
- Mark usage of `@UnstableApi` with `@OptIn(UnstableApi::class)` at the narrowest scope.
- Transformer must be built and started on a thread with a Looper (main thread is fine); it does its heavy work on its own threads.
- Release players and cancel transformers in the appropriate lifecycle callbacks. No leaks.

## Code quality
- No deprecated APIs.
- No `!!` except where provably safe, with a comment explaining why.
- Use `Result`/sealed classes for operations that can fail (import, export, load).
- Unit-test all `model/edit/` functions and `CompositionBuilder` mapping logic.
- User-facing strings go in `strings.xml`.

- This tool simply signals that you're done planning and ready for the user to review and approve

IMPORTANT: Only use this tool when the task requires planning the implementation steps of a task that requires writing code. For research tasks where you're gathering information, searching files, reading files or in general trying to understand the codebase - do NOT use this tool.

## Before Using This Tool
Ensure your plan is complete and unambiguous:
- If you have unresolved questions about requirements or approach, use AskUserQuestion first (in earlier phases)
- Once your plan is finalized, use THIS tool to request approval

**Important:** Do NOT use AskUserQuestion to ask "Is this plan okay?" or "Should I proceed?" - that's exactly what THIS tool does. ExitPlanMode inherently requests user approval of your plan.

## Examples

1. Initial task: "Search for and understand the implementation of vim mode in the codebase" - Do not use the exit plan mode tool because you are not planning the implementation steps of a task.
2. Initial task: "Help me implement yank mode for vim" - Use the exit plan mode tool after you have finished planning the implementation steps of the task.

@Serializable
enum class AspectRatio(val widthRatio: Int, val heightRatio: Int) {
    RATIO_16_9(16, 9),

}

@Serializable
enum class ClipType { VIDEO, IMAGE }

@Serializable
enum class FilterType { NONE, BRIGHTNESS, CONTRAST, SATURATION, GRAYSCALE, WARM, COOL, VINTAGE }

@Serializable
enum class ExportQuality(val shortSidePx: Int) {
    P720(720),
    P1080(1080),
}
package com.savie.precut.model

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

const val DEFAULT_IMAGE_DURATION_MS = 3_000L

/** Highest volume for clips and music (200%). */
const val MAX_VOLUME = 2f

/** Photos have no intrinsic length; this is how far their trim range can be extended. */
const val MAX_IMAGE_DURATION_MS = 60_000L

@Serializable
data class Clip(
    val id: String,
    val uri: String,
    val type: ClipType,
    /** For IMAGE: [MAX_IMAGE_DURATION_MS]; the trim range is the display duration. */
    val sourceDurationMs: Long,
    val trimStartMs: Long = 0,
    /** Exclusive. */
    val trimEndMs: Long,
    val speed: Float = 1f,
    /** Gain for the clip's own audio, 0..[MAX_VOLUME]. */
    val volume: Float = 1f,
    /** Silences the clip without losing [volume]. */
    val muted: Boolean = false,
    /** Fades of the clip's own sound, in timeline time. */
    val fadeInMs: Long = 0,
    val fadeOutMs: Long = 0,
    val filter: FilterType = FilterType.NONE,
    /** User-applied rotation: 0, 90, 180 or 270. */
    val rotationDegrees: Int = 0,
    /** Encoded frame size as stored in the file, before [sourceRotationDegrees] is applied. */
    val sourceWidth: Int = 0,
    val sourceHeight: Int = 0,
    /** Rotation metadata of the source file. */
    val sourceRotationDegrees: Int = 0,
)

/** Media facts read from a source file at import time. */
data class MediaInfo(
    val type: ClipType,
    /** 0 for images. */
    val durationMs: Long,
    val width: Int,
    val height: Int,
    val rotationDegrees: Int,
)

fun clipFromMedia(id: String, uri: String, info: MediaInfo): Clip {
    val (sourceDuration, shownDuration) = when (info.type) {
        ClipType.VIDEO -> info.durationMs to info.durationMs
        ClipType.IMAGE -> MAX_IMAGE_DURATION_MS to DEFAULT_IMAGE_DURATION_MS
    }
    return Clip(
        id = id,
        uri = uri,
        type = info.type,
        sourceDurationMs = sourceDuration,
        trimEndMs = shownDuration,
        sourceWidth = info.width,
        sourceHeight = info.height,
        sourceRotationDegrees = info.rotationDegrees,
    )
}
