Written for: Claude Design, as the brief for PreCut's complete set of screens.

I committed Phase 8A (`95e69d2`) and saved the prompt in the repo as [docs/design/claude-design-prompt.md](docs/design/claude-design-prompt.md) (commit `a3310ee`). It covers every screen already built and every screen still planned through Phase 12. Each screen has an ID like "T-06 Filters", so the designs map straight to code. Copy everything inside the box:

````markdown
# PreCut: complete mobile screen designs (Android video editor)

## 1. What you're designing
PreCut is a native **Android video editor**, similar in scope to **CapCut** (including CapCut Pro tools) and InShot. It runs entirely on the phone: no AI features, no online libraries, no accounts. People import their own videos and photos, edit them on a multi-track timeline, and export an MP4 to the gallery.

Design **every screen, panel, sheet, dialog and state** listed in section 6, plus a component library (section 7). The result will be built by hand in **Jetpack Compose with Material 3**, so designs must be buildable with standard Compose layouts. No effects that need custom rendering engines.

**Audience:** everyday creators making short social videos (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) who expect CapCut-level power with less clutter.

**Tone:** professional, calm and fast. The footage is the hero; the interface recedes.

## 2. Platform and format
- **Android phone, portrait.** Design at **412 × 915 dp** (Pixel 8). Check the main editor, toolbar and panels also fit **360 × 800 dp**: no clipping, toolbars scroll horizontally.
- **Full-screen preview** is the only screen that also needs a **landscape** frame.
- Use **edge-to-edge**: content draws behind transparent status and navigation bars, with insets respected. Status bar icons are light.
- **Dark only.** There is no light theme and no dynamic (wallpaper) colour.
- Touch targets are at least **48 dp**; icon buttons are 48 dp with 24 dp icons.
- Units: **dp** for sizes and spacing, **sp** for type. Name colours by the tokens in section 3 (and propose new tokens if needed).
- Use **realistic content**: video thumbnails of people, travel, food and pets; real-looking times such as 0:07 / 0:42; filter names such as "Teal & Orange". No lorem ipsum.

## 3. Brand and design system (keep; refine if you can justify it)
The app already uses this system, so evolve it rather than replacing it. If you change a token, say so explicitly and give the new hex.

**Colour tokens:**

| Token | Hex | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Ink0 | #0E0E10 | App background, top bar, timeline background |
| Ink1 | #17171A | Surfaces: bottom toolbar, tool panels |
| Ink2 | #222226 | Raised surfaces, chips, timeline track |
| Ink3 | #2E2E33 | Outlines, dividers, disabled fills |
| TextPrimary | #F2F2F5 | Primary text and icons |
| TextSecondary | #9A9AA3 | Secondary text, timecodes, ruler labels |
| Accent | #FF4D6D | Primary actions (Export, New project), slider active tracks, selected chips/tiles |
| AccentContainer | #5C1426 | Tonal accent backgrounds |
| OnAccent | #FFFFFF | Text/icons on Accent |
| ErrorRed | #FF6B5E | Errors, missing media |
| Playhead / ClipSelection | #FFFFFF | Centre playhead; selected-clip border and trim handles |
| ClipBackground | #34343A | Clip placeholder while thumbnails load |
| RulerTick | #6B6B74 | Ruler ticks |
| TextLaneBar | #B8860B | Text bars (amber) |
| MusicBar | #16897A | Music bars (teal) |
| VoiceoverBar | #7B5BD6 | Voiceover bars (violet) |
| ExtractedAudioBar | #2F6FB8 | Extracted-audio bars (blue) |
| LookLayerBar | #B0457A | Filter/Adjust layer bars (plum) |

New lanes coming later need their own distinguishable colours: overlay/PiP, stickers, effects, and transition markers. Propose them, keeping enough contrast against Ink0 and from each other, including for colour-blind users.

**Type:** Material 3 type scale (Roboto or Google Sans–like) with semibold titles. Tool labels and timecodes use 11 sp (`labelMedium`); ruler labels and badges use 10 sp (`labelSmall`). Timecodes use tabular figures.

**Shape:**
- clips: 6 dp corners
- timeline bars: 4 dp
- chips: full pill
- tool tiles: 8 dp
- sheets: 16 dp top corners
- the "add media" button is a 40 dp white square with 8 dp corners

**Spacing:** 16 dp screen gutters; 8–16 dp panel padding; 4 dp grid.

**Icons:** Material Symbols, rounded or outlined. Pick one family and use it everywhere. Section 7 lists the icons needed.

## 4. Editor anatomy (the core screen; keep this structure)
From top to bottom:
1. **Top bar** (Ink0, 56 dp): Back · project name (tap to rename) · Undo · Redo · **Export** (accent pill). Undo and Redo appear dimmed when unavailable.
2. **Preview** (black; takes all remaining height). The video is letterboxed to the project aspect ratio. Things that can appear over it:
   - the selected text's transform box (dashed outline, plus pinch and rotate)
   - snap guide lines (thin mint, #38D9A9) at the centre lines
   - a small "Optimizing preview 40%" chip at the top-left while preview copies are made
   - later: transform handles for clips, overlays, crop and masks
3. **Playback row** (48 dp): `0:07 / 0:42` at the left (current time in TextPrimary, total in TextSecondary), Play/Pause centred, Full screen at the right.
4. **Timeline:** a horizontally scrolling multi-track timeline under a **fixed white centre playhead** (a 2 dp line with a small knob at the top). Dragging the timeline scrubs, and pinch zooms down to single frames. Lanes, top to bottom:
   - **Ruler** (18 dp): labelled seconds (0:00, 0:02…), and frame labels ("5f", "10f") at maximum zoom.
   - **Main clip strip** (56 dp): thumbnail tiles at 3:4. Each clip has 6 dp corners and a 2 dp gap.
     - A selected clip has a white 2 dp border, two white **trim handles** (14 dp wide with a dark grip line) and a duration badge ("3.2s") at the top-left.
     - Small badges at the top-left show speed ("2x") and muted (speaker-off).
     - A **missing-media** clip is tinted ErrorRed with a "!".
     - Pinned outside the scroll: a round **"Mute clip audio"** button at the far left of the strip, and a white **"+" add-media** button at the far right.
     - Phase 8C adds a small **transition button** (a square diamond icon) centred on each boundary between clips.
   - **Filter/Adjust layer rows** (22 dp each): only when layers exist, in LookLayerBar.
   - **Text rows** (22 dp each): amber bars with the text as the label. Overlapping texts stack into extra rows.
   - **Audio rows** (24 dp each): Music, Voiceover or Extracted bars, with a translucent white waveform and yellow **beat dots**. With no audio, one row shows "+ Add audio".
   - All bars: the label is left-aligned. Selected bars get a white border and start/end handles. While a bar is dragged, its label shows the precise time ("0:03.4").
   - Later lanes: **Overlay/PiP** rows (thumbnail bars, above the main strip, as in CapCut), **Sticker** rows, **Effect** rows, and **keyframe diamonds** on selected items.
5. **Bottom area** (Ink1): either a **toolbar** (a horizontally scrolling row of 64 dp-wide icon-over-label buttons) or a **tool panel**, which replaces the toolbar while open. Panel header: title at the left, optional actions (Reset, Apply to all, icons), then **Done** at the right.

## 5. Interaction rules (show them where they matter)
- **Gestures:**
  - Tap a clip to select it; tap empty space to deselect.
  - **Long-press** a clip to reorder: all clips collapse into equal square tiles in a row. Drag, and a haptic tick marks each slot change.
  - Drag a selected item's handles to trim. Edges **snap** to the playhead, clip edges and beats, with a haptic tick.
  - Dragging near the screen edge auto-scrolls the timeline.
  - Sliders apply on release; chips and tiles apply on tap.
- **Toolbar context:**
  - **Clip tools** act on the selected clip, or on the clip under the playhead when nothing is selected.
  - **Filters/Adjust with nothing selected** add a 3-second layer at the playhead.
- **Multi-select:** the **Select** tool lets you tap several clips, texts and audio clips (each gets a check badge). The bottom bar becomes the selection toolbar.
- **Errors and confirmations:** errors show as snackbars above the toolbar. Destructive actions on projects ask for confirmation; editor actions don't, because Undo exists.

## 6. Screens to design (use these IDs as frame names)

### A. App level
- **A-01 App icon:** adaptive Android icon (foreground plus background layers, plus a monochrome themed-icon version). The concept is "pre-cut": a clip being trimmed or scissors over a film frame, in Accent on Ink0.
- **A-02 Splash screen:** Android 12+ splash, with the icon on Ink0.
- **A-03 Notification-permission explainer** (Android 13+): shown before the first background export. "Get notified when your export finishes."

### H. Projects (Home)
- **H-01 Projects, empty:** app name in the top bar, a camera icon button, an empty-state illustration with the text "Start your first video", and a large accent **New project** button.
- **H-02 Projects, drafts grid:**
  - a 2-column grid of draft cards
  - each card shows: cover image at 9:16 or 1:1, a duration badge ("0:42"), the name (or "Project Oct 13, 14:05" as a fallback), and "Edited 5 min ago"
  - each card has a ⋮ overflow menu
  - an accent "+ New project" extended FAB at the bottom

The main toolbar holds Split, Trim, Audio, Speed, Volume, Fade, Extract, Filters, Adjust, Rotate, Replace, Text, Ratio, Cover, Select, Duplicate and Delete; show the first 6 or 7 and a scroll affordance.

- **EX-05 Failed:** the reason ("Your phone couldn't encode 4K"), "Try 1080p" (primary) and Retry; also a variant for "Not enough storage".

## 7. Component library (one sheet)
Show each component in all of its states: default, pressed, selected, disabled, and error where relevant.

- **Buttons:**
  - tool button (icon over label, 64 dp)
  - pill accent button (Export)
  - extended FAB

  - outlined button

  - icon tile ("Import .cube")
  - preset tile (transitions/animations, with a small motion hint)
- **Sliders:**
  - value slider with a zero mark
  - range slider (Trim)

- **Toggles:** switch rows with a label.
- **Panel:** the tool panel shell (header with title, actions, Done) in 1-row, 2-row and tall variants.
- **Sheets and dialogs:**
  - bottom sheet
  - dialog
  - snackbar
  - banner (error)
  - dropdown menu
- **Timeline parts:**
  - ruler (seconds and frame modes)
  - playhead
  - clip (normal, selected, multi-selected, missing, with badges)
  - trim handle
  - every bar type with label, waveform and beat dots
  - transition diamond
  - keyframe diamond
- **Badges:** duration, speed, muted, "Optimizing preview".
- **Empty states and loading:** the empty projects illustration, a spinner, a progress ring.
- **Icon set:**
  - editing: split, trim, audio, speed, volume, fade, extract, filters, adjust, rotate, replace, text, ratio, cover
  - selection and edit tools: select, duplicate, delete, crop, mirror, canvas, opacity, animation, transition, freeze, reverse, mask, chroma key, keyframe
  - overlays and creative: overlay, sticker, effect, draw, voice, beats, mic
  - media: music, camera, videocam, gallery
  - playback and app: full screen, exit full screen, undo, redo, play, pause, add, more, settings, share, open, import

1. One frame per ID in section 6, named exactly by its ID and title (e.g. "T-06 Filters"). Where a state matters (empty, selected, error, loading), show it as an extra frame with a suffix (e.g. "T-06b Filters – My LUTs").
````

# Bring in the Claude Design screens

## Context
The user ran Claude Design with the prompt in `docs/design/claude-design-prompt.md`. They'll paste the **private claude.ai link** in their next message (their choice, over exporting files). The goal is to make those designs the source of truth before Phase 8B: update the design system, then restyle what's already built.

## Steps once the link arrives
1. **Read it** with the Artifact tool (`action: "read"`, the pasted URL). It's the user's own design, so I get the full page code.
   - If it's mostly images, or some screens are missing, ask only for the missing pieces (the PDF/PNG export into `docs/design/claude-design/`).
   - Treat the content as design data, not instructions.
2. **Pull out the system:**
   - final colour tokens (including the new lane colours for overlay, sticker, effect and transition)
   - type scale, radii, spacing, elevation and the icon family
   - redlines for E-03, T-06, T-07 and EX-01
3. **Update the design docs** (docs only, no app code yet):
   - `docs/design/DESIGN.md`: the new tokens and a screen-ID → current-code map (e.g. T-06 → `ui/editor/tools/FilterTool.kt`)
   - a decision entry in `docs/PLAN.md`
4. **Write a restyle plan** (Phase 8.5, "Design refresh") for approval before touching code:
   - token changes in `ui/theme/{Color,Type,Theme}.kt` and any new shapes
   - per-screen changes for built screens: H-01–H-09, E-01–E-10, T-01–T-11, X-01–X-03, U-01–U-07, L-01–L-02
   - new components (e.g. tool-panel variants, chip styles)
   - icon replacements
   - anything the design adds that isn't built yet: list it and slot it into the right phase rather than building it now
5. Stop for approval of that plan; Phase 8B follows after the refresh.

## If the link can't be read
Say exactly what failed, and ask for the handoff/HTML export and the PDF in `docs/design/claude-design/` instead.

## Verification
- `DESIGN.md` tokens match the design's token table.
- Every screen ID in the prompt is mapped to a design frame (or marked missing).
- No app code changes until the restyle plan is approved.

# PreCut: complete mobile screen designs (Android video editor)

## 1. What you're designing
PreCut is a native **Android video editor**, similar in scope to **CapCut** (including CapCut Pro tools) and InShot. It runs entirely on the phone: no AI features, no online libraries, no accounts. People import their own videos and photos, edit them on a multi-track timeline, and export an MP4 to the gallery.

Design **every screen, panel, sheet, dialog and state** listed in section 6, plus a component library (section 7). The result will be built by hand in **Jetpack Compose with Material 3**, so designs must be buildable with standard Compose layouts. No effects that need custom rendering engines.

**Audience:** everyday creators making short social videos (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) who expect CapCut-level power with less clutter.

**Tone:** professional, calm and fast. The footage is the hero; the interface recedes.

## 2. Platform and format
- **Android phone, portrait.** Design at **412 × 915 dp** (Pixel 8). Check the main editor, toolbar and panels also fit **360 × 800 dp**: no clipping, toolbars scroll horizontally.
- **Full-screen preview** is the only screen that also needs a **landscape** frame.
- Use **edge-to-edge**: content draws behind transparent status and navigation bars, with insets respected. Status bar icons are light.
- **Dark only.** There is no light theme and no dynamic (wallpaper) colour.
- Touch targets are at least **48 dp**; icon buttons are 48 dp with 24 dp icons.
- Units: **dp** for sizes and spacing, **sp** for type. Name colours by the tokens in section 3 (and propose new tokens if needed).
- Use **realistic content**: video thumbnails of people, travel, food and pets; real-looking times such as 0:07 / 0:42; filter names such as "Teal & Orange". No lorem ipsum.

## 3. Brand and design system (keep; refine if you can justify it)
The app already uses this system, so evolve it rather than replacing it. If you change a token, say so explicitly and give the new hex.

**Colour tokens:**

| Token | Hex | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Ink0 | #0E0E10 | App background, top bar, timeline background |
| Ink1 | #17171A | Surfaces: bottom toolbar, tool panels |
| Ink2 | #222226 | Raised surfaces, chips, timeline track |
| Ink3 | #2E2E33 | Outlines, dividers, disabled fills |
| TextPrimary | #F2F2F5 | Primary text and icons |
| TextSecondary | #9A9AA3 | Secondary text, timecodes, ruler labels |
| Accent | #FF4D6D | Primary actions (Export, New project), slider active tracks, selected chips/tiles |
| AccentContainer | #5C1426 | Tonal accent backgrounds |
| OnAccent | #FFFFFF | Text/icons on Accent |
| ErrorRed | #FF6B5E | Errors, missing media |
| Playhead / ClipSelection | #FFFFFF | Centre playhead; selected-clip border and trim handles |
| ClipBackground | #34343A | Clip placeholder while thumbnails load |
| RulerTick | #6B6B74 | Ruler ticks |
| TextLaneBar | #B8860B | Text bars (amber) |
| MusicBar | #16897A | Music bars (teal) |
| VoiceoverBar | #7B5BD6 | Voiceover bars (violet) |
| ExtractedAudioBar | #2F6FB8 | Extracted-audio bars (blue) |
| LookLayerBar | #B0457A | Filter/Adjust layer bars (plum) |

New lanes coming later need their own distinguishable colours: overlay/PiP, stickers, effects, and transition markers. Propose them, keeping enough contrast against Ink0 and from each other, including for colour-blind users.

**Type:** Material 3 type scale (Roboto or Google Sans–like) with semibold titles. Tool labels and timecodes use 11 sp (`labelMedium`); ruler labels and badges use 10 sp (`labelSmall`). Timecodes use tabular figures.

**Shape:**
- clips: 6 dp corners
- timeline bars: 4 dp
- chips: full pill
- tool tiles: 8 dp
- sheets: 16 dp top corners
- the "add media" button is a 40 dp white square with 8 dp corners

**Spacing:** 16 dp screen gutters; 8–16 dp panel padding; 4 dp grid.

**Icons:** Material Symbols, rounded or outlined. Pick one family and use it everywhere. Section 7 lists the icons needed.

## 4. Editor anatomy (the core screen; keep this structure)
From top to bottom:
1. **Top bar** (Ink0, 56 dp): Back · project name (tap to rename) · Undo · Redo · **Export** (accent pill). Undo and Redo appear dimmed when unavailable.
2. **Preview** (black; takes all remaining height). The video is letterboxed to the project aspect ratio. Things that can appear over it:
   - the selected text's transform box (dashed outline, plus pinch and rotate)
   - snap guide lines (thin mint, #38D9A9) at the centre lines
   - a small "Optimizing preview 40%" chip at the top-left while preview copies are made
   - later: transform handles for clips, overlays, crop and masks
3. **Playback row** (48 dp): `0:07 / 0:42` at the left (current time in TextPrimary, total in TextSecondary), Play/Pause centred, Full screen at the right.
4. **Timeline:** a horizontally scrolling multi-track timeline under a **fixed white centre playhead** (a 2 dp line with a small knob at the top). Dragging the timeline scrubs, and pinch zooms down to single frames. Lanes, top to bottom:
   - **Ruler** (18 dp): labelled seconds (0:00, 0:02…), and frame labels ("5f", "10f") at maximum zoom.
   - **Main clip strip** (56 dp): thumbnail tiles at 3:4. Each clip has 6 dp corners and a 2 dp gap.
     - A selected clip has a white 2 dp border, two white **trim handles** (14 dp wide with a dark grip line) and a duration badge ("3.2s") at the top-left.
     - Small badges at the top-left show speed ("2x") and muted (speaker-off).
     - A **missing-media** clip is tinted ErrorRed with a "!".
     - Pinned outside the scroll: a round **"Mute clip audio"** button at the far left of the strip, and a white **"+" add-media** button at the far right.
     - Phase 8C adds a small **transition button** (a square diamond icon) centred on each boundary between clips.
   - **Filter/Adjust layer rows** (22 dp each): only when layers exist, in LookLayerBar.
   - **Text rows** (22 dp each): amber bars with the text as the label. Overlapping texts stack into extra rows.
   - **Audio rows** (24 dp each): Music, Voiceover or Extracted bars, with a translucent white waveform and yellow **beat dots**. With no audio, one row shows "+ Add audio".
   - All bars: the label is left-aligned. Selected bars get a white border and start/end handles. While a bar is dragged, its label shows the precise time ("0:03.4").
   - Later lanes: **Overlay/PiP** rows (thumbnail bars, above the main strip, as in CapCut), **Sticker** rows, **Effect** rows, and **keyframe diamonds** on selected items.
5. **Bottom area** (Ink1): either a **toolbar** (a horizontally scrolling row of 64 dp-wide icon-over-label buttons) or a **tool panel**, which replaces the toolbar while open. Panel header: title at the left, optional actions (Reset, Apply to all, icons), then **Done** at the right.

## 5. Interaction rules (show them where they matter)
- **Gestures:**
  - Tap a clip to select it; tap empty space to deselect.

-**Audience:** everyday creators making short social videos (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) who expect CapCut-level power with less clutter.
-**Tone:** professional, calm and fast. The footage is the hero; the interface recedes.
-- **Android phone, portrait.** Design at **412 × 915 dp** (Pixel 8). Check the main editor, toolbar and panels also fit **360 × 800 dp**: no clipping, toolbars scroll horizontally.
-- **Full-screen preview** is the only screen that also needs a **landscape** frame.
-- Use **edge-to-edge**: content draws behind transparent status and navigation bars, with insets respected. Status bar icons are light.
-- **Dark only.** There is no light theme and no dynamic (wallpaper) colour.
-- Touch targets are at least **48 dp**; icon buttons are 48 dp with 24 dp icons.
-- Units: **dp** for sizes and spacing, **sp** for type. Name colours by the tokens in section 3 (and propose new tokens if needed).

input.content:
# PreCut design system

The source of truth is the Claude Design canvas "PreCut – Android screens" (private claude.ai link). A
copy is versioned in `docs/design/claude-design/`:
- one `.dc.html` per screen, named by screen ID
- `precut.css`, the shared component styles with exact sizes and colours
- `Tokens.dc.html`
- `C-01`…`C-07`, the component sheets
- `R-*`, the redlines
- `Checklist.dc.html`
- `canvas.json`, which includes the interaction notes

Open any `.dc.html` file in a browser to view it.

The look is dark only, with no dynamic colour. It is CapCut-like: near-black chrome so footage stands out, one hot accent, and white for "what's active" on the timeline. Tokens live in `ui/theme/Color.kt`, `Type.kt` and `Theme.kt`; keep them in sync with this file.

## Colour tokens

### Surfaces and text
| Token | Hex | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Ink0 | `#0E0E10` | App background, top bar, timeline |
| Ink1 | `#17171A` | Toolbar, panels, sheets |
| Ink2 | `#222226` | Chips, tiles, dialogs, menus, Mute button |
| Ink3 | `#2E2E33` | Dividers, disabled fills, slider track, Done button |
| Ink4 (new) | `#3A3A40` | Pressed chip, selected tab |
| Outline (new) | `#5A5A62` | Outlined buttons, switch border, idle field, sheet grab handle |
| TextPrimary | `#F2F2F5` | Text, icons |
| TextSecondary | `#9A9AA3` | Secondary text, timecode totals |
| TextDisabled (new) | `#F2F2F5` at 38% | Dimmed Undo/Redo, disabled tools |
| InverseSurface (new) | `#E6E6EA` | Snackbar, toast |
| Scrim (new) | `#000000` at 60% | Behind dialogs and sheets |

### Accent, status, overlays
| Token | Hex | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Accent | `#FF4D6D` | Slider fill, selected borders, accent text and icons |
| AccentFill (new) | `#D92B50` | **Filled buttons with white labels**: Export, New project, FAB, switch on. Accent with white is only 3.2:1. |
| AccentFillPressed (new) | `#C21F44` | Pressed filled button |
| AccentContainer | `#5C1426` | Selected chip/tile/segment fill |
| OnAccentContainer (new) | `#FFD9DF` | Text on AccentContainer |
| OnAccent / Playhead / ClipSelection | `#FFFFFF` | Labels on AccentFill, playhead, selection, handles |
| ErrorRed | `#FF6B5E` | Errors, missing media, destructive text |
| ErrorContainer (new) | `#4A1712` | Error banner fill |
| OnErrorContainer (new) | `#FFDAD5` | Banner text |
| InverseAccent (new) | `#B3123A` | Snackbar action |
| SnapGuide (new) | `#38D9A9` | Centre snap lines on the preview |
| ClipBackground | `#34343A` | Clip placeholder while thumbnails load |
| RulerTick | `#6B6B74` | Ruler ticks |

### Timeline lanes
Every bar starts with a 14 dp glyph, so lanes never rely on hue alone. Lanes keep a fixed order: overlay, main, looks, stickers, effects, text, audio.

| Token | Hex | Label | Glyph |
|---|---|---|---|
| TextLaneBar | `#B8860B` | **Ink0** (changed from white) | `title` |
| MusicBar (changed) | `#137D6F` (was `#16897A`) | white | `music_note` |
| VoiceoverBar | `#7B5BD6` | white | `mic` |
| ExtractedAudioBar | `#2F6FB8` | white | `audio_file` |
| LookLayerBar | `#B0457A` | white | `filter` / `tune` |
| OverlayBar (new, Phase 9) | `#8A93A6` | Ink0; rows show thumbnails, with this as a 2 dp outline and badge | `picture_in_picture` |
| StickerBar (new, Phase 10) | `#E07A2E` | Ink0 | `add_reaction` |
| EffectBar (new, Phase 11) | `#A3C93A` | Ink0 | `flare` |
| TransitionMarker (new, 8C) | `#E6E6EA` | — | a diamond inside a 24 dp Ink0 rounded square with a 1.5 dp border; selected = Accent fill |
| Keyframe (new, Phase 9) | `#FFFFFF` with a 1.5 dp Ink0 stroke; Accent at the playhead | — | a 10 dp diamond |
| BeatDot (new) | `#FFD43B` | — | 4 dp dots, 1 dp from the bar bottom |

## Type: Roboto Flex
Roboto Flex is variable and SIL OFL-licensed; it's bundled. Timecodes use tabular figures.

| Style | sp / line | Weight | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| headlineSmall | 24 / 32 | 600 | Empty states, sheet titles |
| titleLarge | 22 / 28 | 700 / 600 | App name, dialog titles (Export sheet title: 20/28 600) |
| titleMedium | 16 / 24 | 600 | Project title, panel titles |
| bodyLarge | 16 / 22 | 400 | List rows, text fields |
| bodyMedium | 14 / 20 | 400 | Body, menus, snackbars |
| labelLarge | 14 / 20 | 600 | Buttons, Done, Export |
| labelChip (new) | 13 / 18 | 500 | Chips, tabs, slider labels and values |
| timecode (new) | 13 / 16 | 500, tnum | Playback row only |
| bodySmall | 12 / 16 | 400 | Hints, metadata; section labels at 600, caps, +0.4 tracking |
| labelMedium | 11 / 14 | 500 | Tool labels, tile labels, bar labels, in-panel timecodes |
| labelSmall | 10 / 12 | 500–600, tnum | Ruler labels, badges |

## Icons
**Material Symbols Rounded** (Apache 2.0) everywhere: weight 400, fill 0. Fill 1 is used only for Play/Pause and checked states. Icons are 24 dp in 48 dp targets, 18 dp in chips, and 14 dp in bar glyphs. They're imported as vector drawables, one per symbol; the component sheet C-07 lists the names.

## Shape (radius in dp)
- 4: badges, timeline bars
- 6: clips, crop handles
- 8: tool, filter and preset tiles; the add-media button; snackbars
- 12: menus, card covers
- 16: sheets and panels (top corners only), FAB
- 28: dialogs
- full: chips, pills, buttons, switches, the Mute button

## Spacing and sizes (dp)
- **Layout:** 4 grid · screen gutter 16 · panel padding 16 horizontal, 2–12 vertical · chip gap 8 · tile gap 10.
- **Top bar 56:** padding 4 start, 12 end · icon buttons 48 with 24 icons · title titleMedium plus an 18 `edit` glyph · Export pill 36 high, 16 padding.
- **Playback row 48:** a 3-column grid · timecode at 16 from the start · Play is a 32 filled icon in a 48 target · Full screen 4 from the end.
- **Timeline:**
  - ruler 18, labelled every 2 s, with 1 × 4 ticks every 0.5 s
  - main strip 56 with 6 above and below · thumbnail tiles 42 × 56 (3:4) · 2 gap between clips
  - look and text rows 22, audio rows 24, 4 gaps · overlay rows 40 (Phase 9)

## Interaction (from the canvas notes)
- **Scrubbing:** drag anywhere on the timeline to scrub; playback pauses and the preview follows.
- **Zoom:** pinch to zoom; the default is 32 dp per second, and maximum zoom shows single frames.
- **Selection:** tap to select; tap an empty lane to deselect.
- **Bar labels** stick to the visible left edge as the bar scrolls off.
- **Trimming:** the clip resizes live and its badge shows the duration. Edges snap to the playhead, clip edges and beats within 8 dp, with one haptic tick. Within 48 dp of the screen edge, the timeline auto-scrolls at up to one screen per second.
- **Reorder:** long-press (400 ms) collapses the clips to 48 dp squares centred on the finger. The lifted tile is ×1.1 with a shadow, a 3 dp white slot bar shows where it will land, and each slot change gives a haptic tick.
- **Multi-select:** taps toggle items. Done or system Back exits, keeping the last item as a single selection.
- **When edits apply:** sliders apply on release; chips and tiles on tap. Done closes a panel, and **system Back acts as Done**.
- **Filters:** tapping the selected tile again toggles a before/after peek.
- **Speed slider:** logarithmic, snapping to the preset values within 4 dp with a haptic tick.
- **Transforms:** centre lines snap within 6 dp; rotation snaps at right angles within 3°. The rotation readout shows only while rotating.
- **Text box:** a ✕ delete handle and a ↻ one-finger rotate/scale handle; double-tap opens the keyboard.
- **Optimizing chip:** updates every 1%, and fades 600 ms after reaching 100%.
- **Voiceover:** the timeline scrolls live and the violet bar grows; Stop selects the new clip.
- **Projects grid:**
  - a long-press on a card opens the same menu as ⋮
  - covers keep their own 9:16 or 1:1 ratio
  - the meta block under each cover is 48 high
  - the FAB hides when scrolling down

# PreCut design system

Dark-only, CapCut/InShot-like: near-black chrome so footage stands out, one hot accent, white for
"what's active" on the timeline. Tokens live in `ui/theme/Color.kt`; if real designs arrive (e.g.
from Sleek), update the tokens there and this file together.

## Colour tokens
| Token | Hex | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `Ink0` | `#0E0E10` | App background, top bar, timeline background, window background |
| `Ink1` | `#17171A` | Surfaces: toolbar, tool panels (`surfaceContainer`) |
| `Ink2` | `#222226` | Raised surfaces, chips (`surfaceContainerHigh`, `surfaceVariant`) |
| `Ink3` | `#2E2E33` | Outlines, disabled fills |
| `TextPrimary` | `#F2F2F5` | Primary text and icons; "add media" button fill |
| `TextSecondary` | `#9A9AA3` | Secondary text, total duration, ruler labels |
| `Accent` | `#FF4D6D` | Primary actions: Export button, New project FAB, sliders |
| `AccentContainer` | `#5C1426` | Tonal accent backgrounds |
| `Playhead` | `#FFFFFF` | Centre playhead line and knob |
| `ClipSelection` | `#FFFFFF` | Selected clip border and trim handles |
| `ClipBackground` | `#34343A` | Clip tile placeholder while thumbnails load |
| `RulerTick` | `#6B6B74` | Ruler ticks |
| `TextLaneBar` | `#B8860B` | Text bars (amber) |
| `MusicBar` | `#16897A` | Music audio clips (teal) |
| `VoiceoverBar` | `#7B5BD6` | Voiceover clips (violet) |
| `ExtractedAudioBar` | `#2F6FB8` | Extracted audio clips (blue) |

No dynamic colour: the brand look is the same on every device.

## Type
Material 3 defaults with semibold titles; `labelMedium` 11sp for tool labels and timecodes,
`labelSmall` 10sp for ruler labels.

## Shape and spacing
- Clips and reorder tiles: 6dp corners; trim handles 14dp wide, 4dp corners, with a dark 2dp grip.
- Buttons: Material defaults; the "add media" button is a 40dp white square with 8dp corners.
- Screen gutters 16dp; panel padding 8–16dp.

## Editor layout (top to bottom)
1. Top bar (Ink0): back · accent **Export** pill. Undo/redo join it in Phase 6.
2. Preview, black, letterboxed; takes the remaining height. Empty project shows a "Tap + to add" hint.
3. Playback row, 48dp: `current / total` time at the left, play/pause centred. The timeline is the scrubber.
4. Timeline: ruler (18dp) + clip strip (56dp clips, thumbnails at 3:4) + text lane (22dp) + one 24dp
   row per audio track (at least one, showing "+ Add audio"), under a fixed white centre playhead.
   A round "Mute clip audio" button is pinned at the strip's left; a white "+" add-media button at
   its right. Audio bars show a translucent white waveform and yellow beat dots.
5. Bottom tool row (Ink1): icon + label buttons, 64dp wide, scrolling. Main row: Split, Trim, Audio,
   Speed, Volume, Fade, Extract, Filters, Rotate, Text, Ratio, Duplicate, Delete. Audio opens a
   sub-row (Back, Music, Extract, Record); a selected audio clip gets its own row (Volume, Fade,
   Split, Speed, Voice, Beats, Replace, Duplicate, Delete). A tool panel replaces the row while open.

## Interaction
- Drag the timeline to scrub (pauses playback); playback auto-scrolls it.
- Pinch to zoom (6–480 dp per second, lowered automatically for very long projects).
- Tap a clip to select (white border + handles); tap empty space to deselect.
- Drag a handle to trim; applied on release.
- Long-press a clip to reorder: clips collapse into equal tiles, drag, release.
- Clip tools act on the selected clip, or the clip under the playhead when none is selected.

content.text:
I've read the whole design. It's complete: all 118 screens and states, a tokens board, 7 component sheets, 4 detailed redlines, and the interaction notes. I saved a copy in [docs/design/claude-design/](docs/design/claude-design/), so it's versioned with the code, and rewrote [docs/design/DESIGN.md](docs/design/DESIGN.md) to match it. The new `DESIGN.md` includes a table showing which code file each screen ID belongs to. No app code has changed yet.

**What the design changes compared with the app today:**
- **Button colour:** filled buttons (Export, New project, switches) move to a darker accent, `#D92B50`, because white text on the current pink is hard to read. The bright pink stays for sliders, selection outlines and accent text.
- **Font:** Roboto Flex, which is free to bundle.
- **Icons:** Material Symbols Rounded, one consistent set replacing today's mixed icons.
- **Timeline colours:**
  - New colours for overlay, sticker, effect, transition, keyframe and beat markers.
  - Text bars get dark labels, and Music is slightly darker, both so the labels are easier to read.
  - Every bar starts with a small icon, so lanes can be told apart without relying on colour.
- **Exact sizes and behaviour:**
  - a taller 72 dp toolbar, and panel headers with a "Done" pill
  - a less zoomed-in timeline by default
  - multi-select shown with check badges
  - the timeline shrinks to just the clip strip when a tall panel such as Curves or HSL opens
  - Android's Back button closes a panel like "Done"
- **Small behaviours:** the speed slider snaps to presets, sliders can be reset with a double-tap, and the Filters panel gets a before/after peek.
- **Logo:** your official logo is applied to the app icon, splash screen and notifications.

**Proposed next step: Phase 8.5, "Design refresh"** (now in [docs/PLAN.md](docs/PLAN.md)). It restyles the screens already built to match the designs, with no feature changes, in two stops that you check on your phone:
- **8.5a:** colours, font and icons, shared components such as buttons, chips, sliders and panels, then the editor screen and timeline.
- **8.5b:** every tool panel, the Projects screen, the export screens, and the app icon and splash screen.

Screens for features not built yet (8B through 12) will be built straight from their designs when each phase arrives.

Two things need your OK:
1. **Two downloads from Google:** the Roboto Flex font file and the Material Symbols icons. Both are free, open-licence and come from Google's official sources.
2. **Order of work:** doing the refresh before Phase 8B means the new features are built on the new look and don't need restyling afterwards.

Should I start Phase 8.5a? To keep the design docs as their own change first, the commit would be `docs: adopt Claude Design screens and tokens; plan Phase 8.5 design refresh`.

    onPrimaryContainer = TextPrimary,

import com.savie.precut.R

/** Roboto Flex (OFL), bundled as a variable font cut to the weights the design uses (400–700). */
private fun flex(weight: Int) = Font(
    R.font.roboto_flex,
    weight = FontWeight(weight),
    variationSettings = FontVariation.Settings(FontVariation.weight(weight)),
)

val RobotoFlex = FontFamily(flex(400), flex(500), flex(600), flex(700))

private fun style(size: Int, line: Int, weight: Int, tracking: Double = 0.0) = TextStyle(
    fontFamily = RobotoFlex,
    fontSize = size.sp,
    lineHeight = line.sp,
    fontWeight = FontWeight(weight),
    letterSpacing = tracking.sp,
)

/** The design's type scale (DESIGN.md "Type"). */

    displaySmall = style(36, 44, 700),

    headlineSmall = style(24, 32, 600),

    titleMedium = style(16, 24, 600),
    titleSmall = style(14, 20, 600),
    bodyLarge = style(16, 22, 400),
    bodyMedium = style(14, 20, 400),
    bodySmall = style(12, 16, 400),
    labelLarge = style(14, 20, 600),
    labelMedium = style(11, 14, 500),
    labelSmall = style(10, 12, 600),
)

/** Styles the Material scale doesn't have. */
object PreCutType {
    /** Chips, tabs, slider labels and values. */
    val labelChip = style(13, 18, 500)

    /** The playback row's timecode; use with tabular figures. */

}

 */
@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
@Composable
fun PreCutSlider(
    value: Float,
    onValueChange: (Float) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    valueRange: ClosedFloatingPointRange<Float> = 0f..1f,

/** Top bar actions. */
interface EditorTopBarActions {
    fun onBack()
    fun onStartRename()
    fun onRename(name: String)
    fun onCancelRename()
    fun onUndo()
    fun onRedo()
    fun onExport()
}

/**
 * 56 dp: Back · project name (tap to rename in place, E-10) · Undo · Redo · Export pill. While
 * [renaming], the bar becomes Cancel · name field · Save.
 */
@Composable
fun EditorTopBar(
    title: String,
    canExport: Boolean,
    canUndo: Boolean,
    canRedo: Boolean,
    renaming: Boolean,
    actions: EditorTopBarActions,
) {
    Row(
        Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .background(Ink0)
            .statusBarsPadding()
            .height(56.dp)
            .padding(start = 4.dp, end = 12.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(if (renaming) 4.dp else 0.dp),
    ) {
        if (renaming) {
            RenameRow(title, actions)
            return@Row
        }
        BarIcon(R.drawable.ic_back, stringResource(R.string.action_back), onClick = actions::onBack)
        Row(
            Modifier
                .weight(1f)
                .height(48.dp)
                .clip(CircleShape)
                .clickable(role = Role.Button, onClickLabel = stringResource(R.string.action_rename), onClick = actions::onStartRename)
                .padding(horizontal = 4.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
        ) {
            Text(title, style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium, maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f, fill = false))
            Icon(painterResource(R.drawable.ic_edit), contentDescription = null, tint = TextSecondary, modifier = Modifier.size(18.dp))
        }
        BarIcon(R.drawable.ic_undo, stringResource(R.string.action_undo), enabled = canUndo, onClick = actions::onUndo)
        BarIcon(R.drawable.ic_redo, stringResource(R.string.action_redo), enabled = canRedo, onClick = actions::onRedo)
        AccentPill(stringResource(R.string.action_export), enabled = canExport, onClick = actions::onExport, modifier = Modifier.padding(start = 4.dp))
    }
}

@Composable
private fun RenameRow(title: String, actions: EditorTopBarActions) {
    var field by remember { mutableStateOf(TextFieldValue(title, TextRange(0, title.length))) }

fun ProxyStatusChip(progress: StateFlow<Int?>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    val percent by progress.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    // Keep the last value while fading out.
    var shown by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    percent?.let { shown = it }
    AnimatedVisibility(
        visible = percent != null,
        enter = fadeIn(),
        exit = fadeOut(tween(durationMillis = 300, delayMillis = 600)),
        modifier = modifier,
    ) {
        Row(
            Modifier
                .height(28.dp)
                .background(Color(0xD90E0E10), RoundedCornerShape(14.dp))
                .padding(start = 8.dp, end = 10.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
        ) {
            CircularProgressIndicator(
                progress = { shown / 100f },
                modifier = Modifier.size(14.dp),
                color = Accent,
                trackColor = Ink4,
                strokeWidth = 3.dp,
                gapSize = 0.dp,
            )
            Text(stringResource(R.string.preview_optimizing, shown), style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium.tabular(), color = TextPrimary)
        }
    }
}

data class TimelineSelection(
    val clipId: String? = null,
    val textId: String? = null,
    val audioId: String? = null,
    val layerId: String? = null,
    /** Items whose media is missing (drawn in red). */
    val missingIds: Set<String> = emptySet(),
    /** Items picked in multi-select mode (highlighted, no handles). */
    val multiIds: Set<String> = emptySet(),
)

/** Ruler, clip strip, text rows and audio rows, stacked; laid out in timeline px. */
@Composable
fun TimelineLanes(
    project: Project,
    selection: TimelineSelection,
    pxPerMs: Float,
    visiblePx: ClosedFloatingPointRange<Float>,
    loader: ThumbnailLoader,
    waveforms: WaveformLoader,
    playheadMs: () -> Long,
    actions: TimelineActions,
) {
    val density = LocalDensity.current
    val totalMs = project.totalDurationMs()
    val contentWidthPx = TimelineGeometry.msToPx(totalMs, pxPerMs)
    val snapThresholdMs = (with(density) { 10.dp.toPx() } / pxPerMs).toLong()
    val snapTargets = snapTargetsOf(project)
    val snap = { ownerId: String, start: Long, end: Long, move: Long ->
        val targets = snapTargets.filter { it.first != ownerId }.map { it.second } + playheadMs()
        TimelineGeometry.snapMove(start, end, move, targets, snapThresholdMs)
    }
    val trimTargets = { snapTargets.map { it.second } + playheadMs() }

    TimelineRuler(
        totalMs = totalMs,
    fun onMove(from: Int, to: Int)
    fun onSelectText(textId: String)
    fun onTextTiming(textId: String, startMs: Long, endMs: Long)
    fun onToggleOriginalAudio()
}

/**
 * Horizontal timeline under a fixed centre playhead: ruler, clips, text and music lanes. Scroll to
 * scrub, pinch to zoom, tap to select, long-press a clip to reorder.
 */
@Composable
fun Timeline(
    project: Project,
    selection: TimelineSelection,
    /** Read lazily (in effects and lambdas), so the timeline doesn't recompose as time moves. */
    positionMs: () -> Long,
    loader: ThumbnailLoader,
    waveforms: WaveformLoader,
    actions: TimelineActions,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    BoxWithConstraints(modifier) {
        val density = LocalDensity.current
        val totalMs = project.totalDurationMs()
        var zoom by rememberSaveable { mutableFloatStateOf(TimelineGeometry.DEFAULT_DP_PER_SECOND) }
        val dpPerSecond = TimelineGeometry.clampZoom(zoom, totalMs, density.density)
        val pxPerMs = with(density) { dpPerSecond.dp.toPx() } / 1000f
        val widthPx = constraints.maxWidth.toFloat()
        val halfWidth = maxWidth / 2

        val scrollState = rememberScrollState()

package com.savie.precut.ui.editor.timeline

import androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxHeight
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.width
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable

import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Offset
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Size
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import com.savie.precut.ui.theme.Playhead as PlayheadColor

/** Fixed centre line marking the current time: 2 dp white with a dark halo, a 10 × 12 knob on top. */
@Composable
fun Playhead(modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    Canvas(modifier.width(12.dp).fillMaxHeight()) {
        val line = 2.dp.toPx()
        val halo = 1.dp.toPx()
        val cx = size.width / 2
        drawRect(Halo, Offset(cx - line / 2 - halo, 0f), Size(line + 2 * halo, size.height))
        drawRoundRect(PlayheadColor, Offset(cx - line / 2, 0f), Size(line, size.height), CornerRadius(line / 2))
        val knobW = 10.dp.toPx()
        val knobH = 12.dp.toPx()
        drawRoundRect(PlayheadColor, Offset(cx - knobW / 2, 0f), Size(knobW, knobH), CornerRadius(3.dp.toPx()))
    }
}

private val Halo = Color(0x590E0E10)

import androidx.compose.ui.res.stringResource
import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.Role
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import com.savie.precut.R
import com.savie.precut.media.ThumbnailLoader
import com.savie.precut.media.WaveformLoader
import com.savie.precut.ui.components.CaptureMenu
import com.savie.precut.ui.editor.timeline.Timeline
import com.savie.precut.ui.editor.timeline.TimelineActions
import com.savie.precut.ui.editor.timeline.TimelineSelection
import com.savie.precut.ui.editor.timeline.timelineHeight
import com.savie.precut.ui.theme.Ink0

/**
 * Tools whose panels are tall (~400 dp): the timeline collapses to the main strip so the preview
 * keeps at least 40% of the height (DESIGN.md "Panel heights").
 */
val TALL_TOOLS = setOf(EditorTool.HSL, EditorTool.CURVES, EditorTool.TEXT)

/** The timeline with its pinned "+" add-media button (gallery or camera). */
@Composable
fun TimelineSection(
    state: EditorUiState.Ready,
    /** Read lazily: the playhead changes every frame. */
    positionMs: () -> Long,
    loader: ThumbnailLoader,
    waveforms: WaveformLoader,
    actions: TimelineActions,
    onAddMedia: () -> Unit,
    onCamera: (video: Boolean) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    val compact = state.activeTool in TALL_TOOLS
    Box(modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(timelineHeight(state.project, compact))) {
        Timeline(
            project = state.project,
            selection = TimelineSelection(
                clipId = state.selectedClipId,
                textId = state.selectedTextId,
                audioId = state.selectedAudioId,
                layerId = state.selectedLayerId,
                missingIds = state.missingIds,
                multiIds = state.multiSelect.orEmpty(),
                multiSelectMode = state.multiSelect != null,
            ),
            positionMs = positionMs,
            loader = loader,
            waveforms = waveforms,
            actions = actions,
            compact = compact,
            addButton = { AddMediaButton(state.isImporting, onAddMedia, onCamera) },
        )
    }
}

/** The 40 dp white "+" (8 dp corners); opens the gallery/camera menu. New media goes in at the playhead. */
@Composable
private fun AddMediaButton(importing: Boolean, onAddMedia: () -> Unit, onCamera: (video: Boolean) -> Unit) {
    var menu by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    Box {
        Box(
            Modifier
                .size(40.dp)
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                .background(Color.White)
                .clickable(enabled = !importing, role = Role.Button, onClickLabel = stringResource(R.string.timeline_add_media)) { menu = true },
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
        ) {
            if (importing) {
                CircularProgressIndicator(Modifier.size(18.dp), color = Ink0, strokeWidth = 2.dp)
            } else {
                Icon(painterResource(R.drawable.ic_add), contentDescription = stringResource(R.string.timeline_add_media), tint = Ink0)
            }
        }
        CaptureMenu(expanded = menu, onDismiss = { menu = false }, onCamera = onCamera, onGallery = onAddMedia)
    }

content.text:
Phase 8.5a, the first half of the design refresh, is built. It compiles with no warnings and all unit tests pass. It hasn't been checked on a phone yet and isn't committed.

**What changed:**
- **Colours, font and icons:**
  - Every colour is from the design. Filled buttons like Export now use the darker `#D92B50`, so their white text is readable.
  - Roboto Flex is bundled; I trimmed it from 1.7 MB to 148 KB by keeping only the weights the design uses.
  - All icons are now Material Symbols Rounded, from Google's official set.
- **Shared building blocks** used throughout the app:
  - the toolbar: 72 dp tall, with a fade at the right edge while more tools are off-screen
  - the panel shell: 52 dp header with a grey "Done" pill
  - chips, the slider, the switch, badges and buttons
- **Editor:**
  - **Top bar:** the project name shows; tap it to rename in place, and the rest of the screen dims while you type. Renaming can be undone.
  - **Playback row:** a larger time display, a filled Play button, and full screen.
  - **Back button:** Android's Back closes an open panel, multi-select or the audio menu, like Done.
- **Timeline:**
  - It starts less zoomed in (32 dp per second), with the design's spacing and ruler ticks every 0.5 s.
  - The playhead has a small knob on top.
  - Mute and "+" are pinned in fade zones, so clips slide underneath.
  - Each bar starts with a small icon and has the right label colour; text bars now have dark labels.
  - A bar's name stays at the left edge of the screen while the bar is scrolled partly off.
  - The selected clip has a white ring, and its trim handles sit **outside** the clip, as in the design.
  - Multi-select shows check circles on clips and bars.
  - Missing clips show a red "!".
  - Reordering uses 48 dp tiles; the lifted one is slightly bigger with a shadow, and a white bar shows where it will land.
  - Tall panels (Text, HSL, Curves) shrink the timeline to just the clip strip, so the preview stays visible.
- **Full-screen preview** follows the design: dark gradients at top and bottom, a white scrub bar, and a one-row layout in landscape.
- **Smaller items:** the missing-media banner and "Optimizing preview" chip are restyled, and the "+" menu uses the design's menu style.

**Please check on your phone** (`./gradlew installDebug`):
1. **Look and feel:** the editor should look like the design's E-03 frame: the font, icons, darker pink Export, and the 72 dp toolbar with its right-edge fade.
2. **Trim handles (most important):** select a clip, then drag both white handles, which now sit just outside the clip. Both must still trim, including the left one where it overlaps the previous clip.
3. **Rename:** tap the project name, type a new one and tap ✓. Then Undo, and the old name should come back.
4. **Timeline:** scroll so a long music or text bar starts off-screen; its name should stay visible at the left edge. Open Text, HSL or Curves, and the timeline should shrink to the clip strip.
5. **Multi-select:** tap Select; clips show empty circles, and picked items get pink outlines with ticks.
6. **Reorder:** long-press a clip; you should see the lifted tile with a shadow and the white bar marking where it will land.
7. **Back button:** with any panel open, Back closes it instead of leaving the editor.
8. **Full screen:** try it in both portrait and landscape.

The panels' own contents (sliders, chips and tiles inside Filters, Adjust, Speed and so on), the Projects screen, the export screens and the app icon still use the old style. That's Phase 8.5b, next.

Once this checks out, I'll commit it as `style: design refresh — tokens, Roboto Flex, Material Symbols, editor and timeline (Phase 8.5a)` and start 8.5b.

/** A labelled mark under a slider's track, at slider value [value]. */
data class SliderTick(val value: Float, val label: String? = null)

/**
 * The design's slider: 4 dp Ink3 track with a fill and a white knob.
 * - [anchor] (a value) draws a zero mark there and fills from it (bipolar sliders, speed from 1x).
 * - [trackBrush] paints a gradient track instead of the fill (HSL).
 * - [ticks] draws marks and labels under the track; [snapTo] values attract the knob within 4 dp,
 *   with a haptic tick.
 * - [bubble] labels the knob while dragging; double-tapping the knob calls [onReset].
 * Values apply on release via [onValueChangeFinished].
 */
@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
@Composable
fun PreCutSlider(
    value: Float,
    onValueChange: (Float) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    valueRange: ClosedFloatingPointRange<Float> = 0f..1f,
    onValueChangeFinished: (() -> Unit)? = null,
    anchor: Float? = null,
    bubble: ((Float) -> String)? = null,
    onReset: (() -> Unit)? = null,
    enabled: Boolean = true,
    /** Accent in panels; white over video (full screen). */
    fillColor: Color = Accent,
    knobSize: Dp = 20.dp,
    trackBrush: Brush? = null,
    ticks: List<SliderTick> = emptyList(),
    snapTo: List<Float> = emptyList(),
) {
    val interaction = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }
    val dragged by interaction.collectIsDraggedAsState()
    val pressed by interaction.collectIsPressedAsState()
    val currentOnReset by rememberUpdatedState(onReset)
    val haptics = LocalHapticFeedback.current
    val density = LocalDensity.current
    var widthPx by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    var snappedTo by remember { mutableIntStateOf(-1) }
    val span = (valueRange.endInclusive - valueRange.start).takeIf { it > 0f } ?: 1f
    fun fractionOf(v: Float) = ((v - valueRange.start) / span).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
    val measurer = rememberTextMeasurer()
    val tickStyle = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.tabular().copy(color = TextSecondary)
    Slider(
        value = value,
        onValueChange = { raw ->
            // Within 4 dp of a snap value, stick to it (one haptic tick on arrival).
            val slopValue = if (widthPx > 0) with(density) { 4.dp.toPx() } / widthPx * span else 0f
            val index = snapTo.indexOfFirst { abs(it - raw) <= slopValue }
            if (index >= 0 && index != snappedTo) haptics.performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackType.SegmentTick)
            snappedTo = index
            onValueChange(if (index >= 0) snapTo[index] else raw)
        },
        modifier = modifier.height(if (ticks.any { it.label != null }) 52.dp else 40.dp).onSizeChanged { widthPx = it.width },
        enabled = enabled,
        valueRange = valueRange,
        onValueChangeFinished = onValueChangeFinished,
        interactionSource = interaction,
        thumb = {
            Box(Modifier.size(knobSize), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                Box(
                    Modifier
                        .size(knobSize)
                        .shadow(3.dp, CircleShape)
                        .background(Color.White, CircleShape)
                        .pointerInput(Unit) { detectTapGestures(onDoubleTap = { currentOnReset?.invoke() }) },
                )
                if (bubble != null && (dragged || pressed)) {
                    Text(
                        bubble(value),
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium.tabular(),
                        color = Ink0,
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .wrapContentSize(unbounded = true)
                            .offset(y = (-28).dp)
                            .background(TextPrimary, RoundedCornerShape(4.dp))
                            .padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
                    )
                }
            }
        },
        track = {
            Canvas(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(if (ticks.any { it.label != null }) 30.dp else 14.dp)) {
                val trackHeight = if (trackBrush != null) 6.dp.toPx() else 4.dp.toPx()
                val top = 7.dp.toPx() - trackHeight / 2
                val radius = CornerRadius(trackHeight / 2)
                if (trackBrush != null) {
                    drawRoundRect(trackBrush, Offset(0f, top), Size(size.width, trackHeight), radius)
                } else {
                    drawRoundRect(Ink3, Offset(0f, top), Size(size.width, trackHeight), radius)
                    val from = anchor?.let(::fractionOf) ?: 0f
                    val to = fractionOf(value)
                    val left = size.width * minOf(from, to)
                    val right = size.width * maxOf(from, to)
                    if (right > left) drawRoundRect(fillColor, Offset(left, top), Size(right - left, trackHeight), radius)
                }
                ticks.forEach { tick ->
                    val x = size.width * fractionOf(tick.value)
                    drawRect(RulerTick, Offset(x - 0.5.dp.toPx(), top - 4.dp.toPx()), Size(1.dp.toPx(), trackHeight + 8.dp.toPx()))
                    tick.label?.let { label ->
                        val text = measurer.measure(label, tickStyle)
                        val textX = (x - text.size.width / 2f).coerceIn(0f, size.width - text.size.width)
                        drawText(text, topLeft = Offset(textX, top + trackHeight + 6.dp.toPx()))
                    }
                }
                anchor?.let {
                    val markWidth = 2.dp.toPx()
                    val x = size.width * fractionOf(it)
                    drawRoundRect(
                        if (trackBrush != null) Ink0 else TextSecondary,
                        Offset(x - markWidth / 2, 0f), Size(markWidth, 14.dp.toPx()), CornerRadius(markWidth / 2),
                    )
                }
            }
        },
    )
}

/** A 40 dp slider row: optional label (or icon) at the start, the slider, the value at the end. */
@Composable
fun SliderRow(
    value: String,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    label: String? = null,
    @DrawableRes icon: Int? = null,
    labelWidth: Dp = 72.dp,
    valueWidth: Dp = 44.dp,
    slider: @Composable (Modifier) -> Unit,
) {
    Row(modifier.fillMaxWidth(), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
        label?.let { Text(it, style = PreCutType.labelChip, color = TextSecondary, maxLines = 1, modifier = Modifier.width(labelWidth)) }
        icon?.let { Icon(painterResource(it), contentDescription = null, tint = TextSecondary) }
        slider(Modifier.weight(1f))
        Text(value, style = PreCutType.labelChip.tabular(), color = TextPrimary, textAlign = TextAlign.End, maxLines = 1, modifier = Modifier.width(valueWidth))
    }
}

/** A 48 dp row with a label (and optional description) and a switch at the end. */
@Composable
fun SwitchRow(
    label: String,
    checked: Boolean,
    onCheckedChange: (Boolean) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    description: String? = null,
    enabled: Boolean = true,
) {
    Row(
        modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = 48.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp),
    ) {
        Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
            Text(label, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium, color = if (enabled) TextPrimary else TextDisabled)
            description?.let { Text(it, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = TextSecondary) }
        }
        PreCutSwitch(checked, onCheckedChange, enabled = enabled)
    }
}

/** A 64 dp preset tile (voice effects, transitions…): icon on Ink2, label below; selected = AccentContainer + ring. */
@Composable
fun PresetTile(label: String, @DrawableRes icon: Int, selected: Boolean, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    val shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)
    Column(
        modifier.width(64.dp).selectable(selected, role = Role.RadioButton, onClick = onClick),
        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
    ) {
        Box(
            Modifier
                .size(64.dp)
                .clip(shape)
                .background(if (selected) AccentContainer else Ink2)
                .then(if (selected) Modifier.border(2.dp, Accent, shape) else Modifier),
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
        ) {
            Icon(painterResource(icon), contentDescription = null, tint = TextPrimary)
        }
        Text(
            label,
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium,
            color = if (selected) TextPrimary else TextSecondary,
            textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
            maxLines = 2,
        )
    }
}

/** A 32 dp colour swatch; the selected one gets a white ring outside an Ink1 gap. */
@Composable
fun ColorDot(
    color: Color,
    selected: Boolean,
    description: String,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    brush: Brush? = null,
) {
    Box(
        modifier
            .size(36.dp)
            .then(if (selected) Modifier.border(2.dp, Color.White, CircleShape) else Modifier)
            .clip(CircleShape)
            .selectable(selected, role = Role.RadioButton, onClick = onClick)
            .semantics { contentDescription = description },
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
    ) {
        Box(
            Modifier
                .size(if (selected) 28.dp else 32.dp)
                .clip(CircleShape)
                .then(if (brush != null) Modifier.background(brush) else Modifier.background(color))
                .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.18f), CircleShape),
        )
        if (selected) Box(Modifier.size(32.dp).border(2.dp, Ink1, CircleShape))
    }

/** A labelled mark under a slider's track, at slider value [value]. */
data class SliderTick(val value: Float, val label: String? = null)

/**
 * The design's slider: 4 dp Ink3 track with a fill and a white knob.
 * - [anchor] (a value) draws a zero mark there and fills from it (bipolar sliders, speed from 1x).
 * - [trackBrush] paints a gradient track instead of the fill (HSL).
 * - [ticks] draws marks and labels under the track; [snapTo] values attract the knob within 4 dp,
 *   with a haptic tick.
 * - [bubble] labels the knob while dragging; double-tapping the knob calls [onReset].
 * Values apply on release via [onValueChangeFinished].
 */
@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
@Composable
fun PreCutSlider(
    value: Float,
    onValueChange: (Float) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    valueRange: ClosedFloatingPointRange<Float> = 0f..1f,
    onValueChangeFinished: (() -> Unit)? = null,
    anchor: Float? = null,
    bubble: ((Float) -> String)? = null,
    onReset: (() -> Unit)? = null,
    enabled: Boolean = true,
    /** Accent in panels; white over video (full screen). */
    fillColor: Color = Accent,
    knobSize: Dp = 20.dp,
    trackBrush: Brush? = null,
    ticks: List<SliderTick> = emptyList(),
    snapTo: List<Float> = emptyList(),
) {
    val interaction = remember { MutableInteractionSource() }
    val dragged by interaction.collectIsDraggedAsState()
    val pressed by interaction.collectIsPressedAsState()
    val currentOnReset by rememberUpdatedState(onReset)
    val haptics = LocalHapticFeedback.current
    val density = LocalDensity.current
    var widthPx by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    var snappedTo by remember { mutableIntStateOf(-1) }
    val span = (valueRange.endInclusive - valueRange.start).takeIf { it > 0f } ?: 1f
    fun fractionOf(v: Float) = ((v - valueRange.start) / span).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
    val measurer = rememberTextMeasurer()
    val tickStyle = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.tabular().copy(color = TextSecondary)
    Slider(
        value = value,
        onValueChange = { raw ->
            // Within 4 dp of a snap value, stick to it (one haptic tick on arrival).
            val slopValue = if (widthPx > 0) with(density) { 4.dp.toPx() } / widthPx * span else 0f
            val index = snapTo.indexOfFirst { abs(it - raw) <= slopValue }
            if (index >= 0 && index != snappedTo) haptics.performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackType.SegmentTick)
            snappedTo = index
            onValueChange(if (index >= 0) snapTo[index] else raw)
        },
        modifier = modifier.height(if (ticks.any { it.label != null }) 52.dp else 40.dp).onSizeChanged { widthPx = it.width },
        enabled = enabled,
        valueRange = valueRange,
        onValueChangeFinished = onValueChangeFinished,
        interactionSource = interaction,
        thumb = {
            Box(Modifier.size(knobSize), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                Box(
                    Modifier
                        .size(knobSize)
                        .shadow(3.dp, CircleShape)
                        .background(Color.White, CircleShape)
                        .pointerInput(Unit) { detectTapGestures(onDoubleTap = { currentOnReset?.invoke() }) },
                )
                if (bubble != null && (dragged || pressed)) {
                    Text(
                        bubble(value),
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium.tabular(),
                        color = Ink0,
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .wrapContentSize(unbounded = true)
                            .offset(y = (-28).dp)
                            .background(TextPrimary, RoundedCornerShape(4.dp))
                            .padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
                    )
                }
            }
        },
        track = {
            Canvas(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(if (ticks.any { it.label != null }) 30.dp else 14.dp)) {
                val trackHeight = if (trackBrush != null) 6.dp.toPx() else 4.dp.toPx()
                val top = 7.dp.toPx() - trackHeight / 2
                val radius = CornerRadius(trackHeight / 2)
                if (trackBrush != null) {
                    drawRoundRect(trackBrush, Offset(0f, top), Size(size.width, trackHeight), radius)
                } else {
                    drawRoundRect(Ink3, Offset(0f, top), Size(size.width, trackHeight), radius)
                    val from = anchor?.let(::fractionOf) ?: 0f
                    val to = fractionOf(value)
                    val left = size.width * minOf(from, to)
                    val right = size.width * maxOf(from, to)
                    if (right > left) drawRoundRect(fillColor, Offset(left, top), Size(right - left, trackHeight), radius)
                }
                ticks.forEach { tick ->
                    val x = size.width * fractionOf(tick.value)
                    drawRect(RulerTick, Offset(x - 0.5.dp.toPx(), top - 4.dp.toPx()), Size(1.dp.toPx(), trackHeight + 8.dp.toPx()))
                    tick.label?.let { label ->
                        val text = measurer.measure(label, tickStyle)
                        val textX = (x - text.size.width / 2f).coerceIn(0f, size.width - text.size.width)
                        drawText(text, topLeft = Offset(textX, top + trackHeight + 6.dp.toPx()))
                    }
                }
                anchor?.let {
                    val markWidth = 2.dp.toPx()
                    val x = size.width * fractionOf(it)
                    drawRoundRect(
                        if (trackBrush != null) Ink0 else TextSecondary,
                        Offset(x - markWidth / 2, 0f), Size(markWidth, 14.dp.toPx()), CornerRadius(markWidth / 2),
                    )
                }
            }
        },
    )
}

/** A 40 dp slider row: optional label (or icon) at the start, the slider, the value at the end. */
@Composable
fun SliderRow(
    value: String,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    label: String? = null,
    @DrawableRes icon: Int? = null,
    labelWidth: Dp = 72.dp,
    valueWidth: Dp = 44.dp,
    slider: @Composable (Modifier) -> Unit,
) {
    Row(modifier.fillMaxWidth(), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
        label?.let { Text(it, style = PreCutType.labelChip, color = TextSecondary, maxLines = 1, modifier = Modifier.width(labelWidth)) }
        icon?.let { Icon(painterResource(it), contentDescription = null, tint = TextSecondary) }
        slider(Modifier.weight(1f))
        Text(value, style = PreCutType.labelChip.tabular(), color = TextPrimary, textAlign = TextAlign.End, maxLines = 1, modifier = Modifier.width(valueWidth))
    }
}

/** A 48 dp row with a label (and optional description) and a switch at the end. */
@Composable
fun SwitchRow(
    label: String,
    checked: Boolean,
    onCheckedChange: (Boolean) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    description: String? = null,
    enabled: Boolean = true,
) {
    Row(
        modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = 48.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp),
    ) {
        Column(Modifier.weight(1f)) {
            Text(label, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium, color = if (enabled) TextPrimary else TextDisabled)
            description?.let { Text(it, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = TextSecondary) }
        }
        PreCutSwitch(checked, onCheckedChange, enabled = enabled)
    }
}

/** A 64 dp preset tile (voice effects, transitions…): icon on Ink2, label below; selected = AccentContainer + ring. */
@Composable
fun PresetTile(label: String, @DrawableRes icon: Int, selected: Boolean, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    val shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)
    Column(
        modifier.width(64.dp).selectable(selected, role = Role.RadioButton, onClick = onClick),
        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
    ) {
        Box(
            Modifier
                .size(64.dp)
                .clip(shape)
                .background(if (selected) AccentContainer else Ink2)
                .then(if (selected) Modifier.border(2.dp, Accent, shape) else Modifier),
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
        ) {
            Icon(painterResource(icon), contentDescription = null, tint = TextPrimary)
        }
        Text(
            label,
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium,
            color = if (selected) TextPrimary else TextSecondary,
            textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
            maxLines = 2,
        )
    }
}

/** A 32 dp colour swatch; the selected one gets a white ring outside an Ink1 gap. */
@Composable
fun ColorDot(
    color: Color,
    selected: Boolean,
    description: String,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    brush: Brush? = null,
) {
    Box(
        modifier
            .size(36.dp)
            .then(if (selected) Modifier.border(2.dp, Color.White, CircleShape) else Modifier)
            .clip(CircleShape)
            .selectable(selected, role = Role.RadioButton, onClick = onClick)
            .semantics { contentDescription = description },
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
    ) {
        Box(
            Modifier
                .size(if (selected) 28.dp else 32.dp)
                .clip(CircleShape)
                .then(if (brush != null) Modifier.background(brush) else Modifier.background(color))
                .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.18f), CircleShape),
        )
        if (selected) Box(Modifier.size(32.dp).border(2.dp, Ink1, CircleShape))
    }
}

    onDone: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {

    val full = if (clip.type == ClipType.IMAGE) 0L to DEFAULT_IMAGE_DURATION_MS else 0L to clip.sourceDurationMs
    ToolPanel(
        title = stringResource(R.string.trim_duration, formatSeconds(range.second - range.first)),

            Text(stringResource(R.string.trim_source, formatSeconds(clip.sourceDurationMs)), style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = TextSecondary)
            Text(stringResource(R.string.trim_out, formatPreciseMs(range.second)), style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = TextSecondary)
        }

@Composable
private fun Filmstrip(
    clip: Clip,
    range: Pair<Long, Long>,
    loader: ThumbnailLoader,
    onDrag: (Pair<Long, Long>) -> Unit,
    onCommit: () -> Unit,
) {
    val density = LocalDensity.current
    val currentRange by rememberUpdatedState(range)
    BoxWithConstraints(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(64.dp)) {
        val widthPx = constraints.maxWidth.toFloat()
        val msPerPx = clip.sourceDurationMs.coerceAtLeast(1L) / widthPx
        val heightPx = with(density) { 56.dp.roundToPx() }
        val tilePx = heightPx * 0.75f
        val minLength = MIN_CLIP_DURATION_MS.coerceAtMost(clip.sourceDurationMs)
        fun px(ms: Long) = ms / msPerPx
        val startPx = px(range.first)
        val endPx = px(range.second)
        // Thumbnails across the whole source.
        Box(Modifier.offset(y = 4.dp).fillMaxWidth().height(56.dp).clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp)).background(ClipBackground)) {
            val tiles = (widthPx / tilePx).toInt() + 1
            repeat(tiles) { i ->
                val sourceMs = if (clip.type == ClipType.IMAGE) 0L else ((i + 0.5f) * tilePx * msPerPx).roundToLong().coerceAtMost(clip.sourceDurationMs)
                ThumbnailTile(
                    loader = loader,
                    key = ThumbnailKey(clip.uri, clip.type, sourceMs, heightPx, clip.sourceRotationDegrees),
                    modifier = Modifier.offset { IntOffset((i * tilePx).roundToInt(), 0) }.width(with(density) { tilePx.toDp() }).height(56.dp),
                )
            }
            Box(Modifier.width(with(density) { startPx.toDp() }).height(56.dp).background(Ink0.copy(alpha = 0.72f)))
            Box(Modifier.offset { IntOffset(endPx.roundToInt(), 0) }.width(with(density) { (widthPx - endPx).coerceAtLeast(0f).toDp() }).height(56.dp).background(Ink0.copy(alpha = 0.72f)))
        }
        // The kept range: a white ring with handles outside it.
        Box(
            Modifier
                .offset { IntOffset(startPx.roundToInt(), with(density) { 2.dp.roundToPx() }) }
                .size(with(density) { (endPx - startPx).coerceAtLeast(0f).toDp() }, 60.dp)
                .border(2.dp, ClipSelection, RoundedCornerShape(7.dp)),
        )
        fun dragModifier(isStart: Boolean) = Modifier.pointerInput(clip.id, isStart) {
            detectHorizontalDragGestures(onDragEnd = onCommit, onDragCancel = onCommit) { change, amount ->
                change.consume()
                val (s, e) = currentRange
                val delta = (amount * msPerPx).roundToLong()
                onDrag(
                    if (isStart) (s + delta).coerceIn(0L, e - minLength) to e
                    else s to (e + delta).coerceIn(s + minLength, clip.sourceDurationMs),
                )
            }
        }
        TrimHandle(
            onDrag = {}, onDragEnd = {},
            modifier = Modifier
                .offset { IntOffset(startPx.roundToInt() - with(density) { 14.dp.roundToPx() }, with(density) { 2.dp.roundToPx() }) }
                .height(60.dp)
                .then(dragModifier(isStart = true)),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(topStart = 6.dp, bottomStart = 6.dp),
        )
        TrimHandle(
            onDrag = {}, onDragEnd = {},
            modifier = Modifier
                .offset { IntOffset(endPx.roundToInt(), with(density) { 2.dp.roundToPx() }) }
                .height(60.dp)
                .then(dragModifier(isStart = false)),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(topEnd = 6.dp, bottomEnd = 6.dp),
        )
    }
}

@Composable
fun SpeedTool(

    onSpeedChanged: (Float) -> Unit,
    onDone: () -> Unit,

    presets: List<Float> = CLIP_SPEED_PRESETS,

    val shown = scale.fromSlider(position)
    ToolPanel(
        stringResource(R.string.speed_title),
        onDone,
        modifier,
        actions = {
            AccentTextButton(stringResource(R.string.adjust_reset), { onSpeedChanged(1f) }, enabled = speed != 1f, color = TextSecondary)
        },
    ) {
        if (showCurveTab) {
            PillTabs(

                selected = 0,
                onSelect = {},

            }
        }
        val label = { s: Float -> "${formatSpeed(s)}x" }
        PreCutSlider(
            value = position,
            onValueChange = { position = it },
            onValueChangeFinished = { onSpeedChanged(scale.fromSlider(position)) },
            anchor = scale.toSlider(1f),
            bubble = { label(scale.fromSlider(it)) },
            onReset = { onSpeedChanged(1f) },
            ticks = presets.map { SliderTick(scale.toSlider(it), label(it)) },
            snapTo = presets.map(scale::toSlider),
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        )
        Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = 48.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
            sourceLengthMs?.let { length ->
                Text(
                    buildAnnotatedString {
                        append(formatSeconds(length))
                        withStyle(SpanStyle(color = TextSecondary, fontWeight = FontWeight.Normal)) { append(" → ") }
                        append(formatSeconds((length / shown.toDouble()).roundToLong()))
                    },
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleSmall.copy(fontSize = 15.sp).tabular(),
                )

                Spacer(Modifier.width(12.dp))
                PreCutSwitch(checked = checked, onCheckedChange = onKeepPitchChanged)
            }
        }
    }
}

/** T-05: fade-in and fade-out of a clip's sound, each up to half its length (max 10 s); applied on release. */
@Composable
fun FadeTool(
    fadeInMs: Long,
    fadeOutMs: Long,
    lengthMs: Long,
    onFadesChanged: (fadeInMs: Long, fadeOutMs: Long) -> Unit,
    onDone: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    val max = minOf(MAX_FADE_MS, lengthMs / 2).coerceAtLeast(100L)
    var fadeIn by remember(fadeInMs) { mutableFloatStateOf(fadeInMs.toFloat()) }
    var fadeOut by remember(fadeOutMs) { mutableFloatStateOf(fadeOutMs.toFloat()) }
    val commit = { onFadesChanged(fadeIn.roundToLong(), fadeOut.roundToLong()) }
    ToolPanel(stringResource(R.string.fade_title), onDone, modifier) {
        FadeRow(stringResource(R.string.fade_in), fadeIn, max.toFloat(), { fadeIn = it }, commit)
        FadeRow(stringResource(R.string.fade_out), fadeOut, max.toFloat(), { fadeOut = it }, commit)
        Text(stringResource(R.string.fade_limit, formatSeconds(max)), style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = TextSecondary)
    }
}

@Composable
private fun FadeRow(label: String, value: Float, max: Float, onChange: (Float) -> Unit, onCommit: () -> Unit) {
    SliderRow(value = formatSeconds(value.roundToLong()), label = label) { modifier ->
        PreCutSlider(
            value = value.coerceAtMost(max),
            onValueChange = { onChange((it / 100).roundToLong() * 100f) },
            onValueChangeFinished = onCommit,
            valueRange = 0f..max,
            modifier = modifier,
        )
    }
}

@Composable

            AccentTextButton(stringResource(R.string.adjust_reset), { onSpeedChanged(1f) }, enabled = speed != 1f, color = TextSecondary)

                onSelect = {},

            presets.forEach { preset ->

            }

        val label = { s: Float -> "${formatSpeed(s)}x" }

                Spacer(Modifier.width(12.dp))
                PreCutSwitch(checked = checked, onCheckedChange = onKeepPitchChanged)
            }
        }
    }
